sentences.en: I'm gonna duck into the convenience store across the street.

sentences.zh: 好，进去避一会儿。
sentences.en: Good idea. Shelter there for a while.

sentences.zh: 妈呀我刚进来雨就变大了，瓢泼大雨。
sentences.en: Oh my god, the second I stepped inside, the sky just opened up!

sentences.zh: 你进去得很及时。
sentences.en: You got inside just in time.

sentences.zh: 天呐下冰雹了，好大的冰雹。
sentences.en: Holy crap, it's hailing! Those hailstones are huge!

sentences.zh: 待在室内，离窗户远一点。
sentences.en: Stay indoors and keep away from the windows.

sentences.zh: 现在又是打雷又是闪电的好吓人啊。
sentences.en: Now it's all thunder and lightning—it's honestly pretty terrifying.

sentences.zh: 先安心待在里面，等天气好转。
sentences.en: Stay inside and wait for the weather to improve.

sentences.zh: 雨停了
sentences.en: The rain cleared up!

sentences.zh: 终于停了，出去前再看看情况。
sentences.en: It finally stopped. Check outside before leaving.

sentences.zh: 出彩虹了耶！太漂亮了！
sentences.en: Look, a rainbow came out! That is so gorgeous!

sentences.zh: 雨后的惊喜呀！
sentences.en: What a lovely surprise after the rain!

sentences.zh: 下雪啦！这是今年的初雪耶！
sentences.en: It's snowing! This is the first snow of the year!

sentences.zh: 初雪总让人特别兴奋。
sentences.en: The first snow is always exciting.

sentences.zh: 而且这个雪花好大啊，好漂亮。
sentences.en: And the snowflakes are huge—it's so pretty!

sentences.zh: 大雪花飘下来一定很好看。
sentences.en: Those big snowflakes must look lovely.

sentences.zh: 天气预报说会下一晚上呢。
sentences.en: The forecast says it's gonna snow all night.

sentences.zh: 明早说不定就白茫茫一片了。
sentences.en: It might be all white by morning.

sentences.zh: 明天一大早我就要去堆雪人。
sentences.en: First thing tomorrow morning, I'm gonna go build a snowman!

sentences.zh: 想好堆什么样的雪人了吗？
sentences.en: Have you planned your snowman?

sentences.zh: 我哥他们要去打雪仗，我不喜欢，我就喜欢堆雪人。
sentences.en: My brother and his friends are planning a snowball fight, but I'm not really into that—I just wanna stick to building snowmen.

sentences.zh: 那就各玩各喜欢的。
sentences.en: Then everyone can enjoy their own thing.

sentences.zh: 我要去找个胡萝卜给雪人当鼻子。
sentences.en: I gotta go grab a carrot to use for the snowman's nose.

sentences.zh: 胡萝卜鼻子很经典。
sentences.en: A carrot nose is a classic.

sentences.zh: 你说用蓝莓当雪人的眼睛会不会有点太小了。
sentences.en: Do you think blueberries are a bit too small for the eyes?

sentences.zh: 如果雪人很大，蓝莓可能不太显眼。
sentences.en: Blueberries might not stand out on a big snowman.

sentences.zh: 我全都准备好了，就等着明天早上了，祈祷雪一定要下厚一点！
sentences.en: I'm all set—just waiting on tomorrow morning. Fingers crossed we get a really thick layer of snow!

sentences.zh: 准备得很充分，期待明天吧。
sentences.en: You're all set. Something to look forward to tomorrow!

episodes.title: 健身俩小时酸痛一整天

sentences.zh: 我昨天去健身房炼了两个小时。
sentences.en: I hit the gym for two hours yesterday.

sentences.zh: 练了哪些项目？
sentences.en: What exercises did you do?

sentences.zh: 今天我的肩膀,胳膊,大腿都特别酸。
sentences.en: Today my shoulders, arms, and thighs are all killing me.

sentences.zh: 听起来今天活动都不太方便。
sentences.en: Moving around must feel uncomfortable today.

sentences.zh: 可能是拉伸不够，也可能是我太久没锻炼了。
sentences.en: Probably didn't stretch enough, or maybe I just haven't worked out in way too long.

sentences.zh: 可能有多种原因，不急着自己下结论。
sentences.en: There could be several reasons. No need to jump to conclusions.

sentences.zh: 教练说让我休息两天再去练，今天就别去了。
sentences.en: My trainer said to take two days off and skip today.

sentences.zh: 那就按教练的安排先休息。
sentences.en: Then follow your trainer's plan and rest first.

sentences.zh: 我得坚持锻炼，我上周体检，医生说我肌肉太少脂肪太多了。
sentences.en: I gotta stay consistent—I had a checkup last week and the doctor said I have low muscle mass and my body fat is too high.

sentences.zh: 有医生和教练指导，慢慢建立习惯。
sentences.en: Build the habit gradually with guidance from your doctor and trainer.

sentences.zh: 反正我打算以后一周至少要去两次健身房。
sentences.en: Anyway, I'm planning to hit the gym at least twice a week from now on.

sentences.zh: 规律一点，比一下子练太猛更容易坚持。
sentences.en: A steady routine can be easier to maintain than doing too much at once.

sentences.zh: 以后每次锻炼我都要好好拉伸一下。
sentences.en: And I'm gonna make sure I stretch properly every single time.

sentences.zh: 可以和教练确认适合你的热身和放松方式。
sentences.en: Ask your trainer about warm-ups and cool-downs that suit you.

sentences.zh: 最近只要一降温我就感冒，这身体素质真的越来越差了。
sentences.en: Lately I catch a cold every time the temperature drops—my body's really falling apart.

sentences.zh: 老是生病确实很累，去看过医生了吗？
sentences.en: Being ill so often is tiring. Have you seen a doctor?

sentences.zh: 医生说我这是典型的免疫力低下。
sentences.en: The doctor said it's a classic case of a weak immune system.

sentences.zh: 那就和医生一起看看怎么调整。
sentences.en: Then work with your doctor on what to change.

sentences.zh: 最近都没好好吃饭，睡的也晚。
sentences.en: I haven't been eating properly lately, and I've been going to bed way too late.

sentences.zh: 吃饭和休息都值得认真照顾。
sentences.en: Meals and rest both deserve attention.

sentences.zh: 医生让我11点前就睡，他说我的身体器官11点就要休息了。
sentences.en: The doctor told me to be in bed by eleven PM—said my organs need to rest by then.

sentences.zh: 规律睡眠很重要，不过器官不会到十一点就统一停止工作。
sentences.en: Regular sleep matters, but your organs don't all stop working at eleven.

sentences.zh: 但是太难了，我一上床就想玩手机。
sentences.en: But it's so hard—as soon as I get in bed, I wanna scroll on my phone.

sentences.zh: 可以先把手机放到床边够不到的地方。
sentences.en: You could put your phone out of reach before bed.

sentences.zh: 你说我吃点维生素行吗？提升一下免疫力。
sentences.en: Do you think I should take some vitamins? To boost my immune system?

sentences.zh: 是否需要补充，先问问医生或药师。
sentences.en: Ask your doctor or pharmacist whether you need supplements.

sentences.zh: 我吃了一颗，现在10点20，我把这把游戏打完就睡。
sentences.en: I just took one. It's ten twenty now—I'll sleep right after I finish this round.

sentences.zh: 那打完这局就收手机，给自己留点休息时间。
sentences.en: Put the phone away after this round and give yourself time to rest.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我的眉毛好淡啊，你说我要纹眉吗？
sentences.en: I feel like my eyebrows are so light—do you think I should get them microbladed?

sentences.zh: 你可以先用眉笔试试喜欢的眉形。
sentences.en: You could try an eyebrow pencil to see what shape you like.

sentences.zh: 我一个同事的眉毛可浓了，特别好看。
sentences.en: One of my coworkers has such full eyebrows—they look great.

sentences.zh: 每个人的眉毛都有自己的特点。
sentences.en: Everyone's eyebrows are different.

sentences.zh: 我再考虑一下吧，有点怕疼
sentences.en: I'll think about it—kinda scared of the pain though.

sentences.zh: 不急，了解清楚再决定。
sentences.en: No rush. Learn more before deciding.

sentences.zh: 你说我要不要割个双眼皮呢 ，大家都说单眼皮不好看。
sentences.en: Do you think I should get double eyelid surgery? Everyone says monolids don't look good.

sentences.zh: 单眼皮并不等于不好看，重要的是你自己的感受。
sentences.en: Single eyelids aren't unattractive. What matters is how you feel.

sentences.zh: 嗯，其实我还挺喜欢自己的单眼皮的。
sentences.en: Actually, I kinda like my monolids.

sentences.zh: 那就不必为了别人改变它。
sentences.en: Then you don't need to change them for others.

sentences.zh: 我觉得我的鼻子耳朵也都长得很可爱。
sentences.en: I think my nose and ears are cute too.

sentences.zh: 能看到自己的可爱之处很棒。
sentences.en: It's lovely that you notice what you like about yourself.

sentences.zh: 我最喜欢自己的额头了，我额头可饱满了。
sentences.en: My favorite feature is my forehead—it's so full and round.

sentences.zh: 你很清楚自己喜欢什么。
sentences.en: You know what you like about yourself.

sentences.zh: 虽然我眉毛很淡，眼睛也是单眼皮，但我还是很喜欢自己。
sentences.en: Even though I have light eyebrows and monolids, I still love myself.

sentences.zh: 这样的自信很珍贵。
sentences.en: That confidence is valuable.

sentences.zh: 今天我们公司新来了一个男同事，大家都说他超级帅。
sentences.en: A new guy started at our company today, and everyone's saying he's super hot.

sentences.zh: 你见到他了吗？
sentences.en: Have you met him yet?

sentences.zh: 我刚刚去茶水间碰到了，感觉长得挺普通的呀，就个子很高，快1米九。
sentences.en: I just ran into him in the break room—honestly, he looks pretty average to me. Just really tall, like almost 6'3"(six three).

sentences.zh: 看来你和大家的审美不太一样。
sentences.en: Sounds like your taste differs from theirs.

sentences.zh: 不过他笑起来的时候有两个酒窝，这点还挺加分的。
sentences.en: But he's got dimples when he smiles, which is a nice bonus.

sentences.zh: 笑起来的感觉可能更亲切。
sentences.en: His smile might make him seem friendlier.

sentences.zh: 他人也挺有礼貌的，我喜欢有礼貌的人。
sentences.en: He seems really polite too—I like people with good manners.

sentences.zh: 礼貌确实很加分。
sentences.en: Good manners really make a difference.

sentences.zh: 我同事Linda觉得他长得像张凌赫，她是张凌赫粉丝。
sentences.en: My coworker Linda thinks he looks like Zhang Linghe—she's a huge fan of his.

sentences.zh: 难怪她对他印象这么好。
sentences.en: No wonder he made such an impression on her.

sentences.zh: Linda想让我帮她要这个新同事的微信呢哈哈
sentences.en: Linda wants me to get his WeChat for her, haha.

sentences.zh: 可以先问问他愿不愿意交换联系方式。
sentences.en: You could ask whether he'd like to exchange contact details.

sentences.zh: 我下午试试看。
sentences.en: I'll try this afternoon.

sentences.zh: 好，尊重他的意愿就行。
sentences.en: Sure. Just respect his wishes.

sentences.zh: 刚才在电梯里见到一个小女孩，超级可爱，才两岁。
sentences.en: I just saw this little girl in the elevator—she was so adorable, only two years old.

sentences.zh: 两岁的小朋友很会让人开心。
sentences.en: Little children can really brighten your day.

sentences.zh: 她一见到我就跟我说，你好。啊我的心都要化了
sentences.en: She looked at me and said "hello"—aww, my heart literally melted.

sentences.zh: 她主动打招呼，真可爱。
sentences.en: How sweet that she said hello first.

sentences.zh: 我问她你几岁了，她伸出两个手指头跟我说两岁，太可爱了
sentences.en: I asked her how old she was, and she held up two little fingers and said "two." So cute.

sentences.zh: 还会用手指比出来呢！
sentences.en: She even showed you with her fingers!

sentences.zh: 她穿的也很可爱，穿了一个艾莎公主的裙子和水晶鞋。
sentences.en: She was dressed super cute too—wearing an Elsa dress and sparkly shoes.

sentences.zh: 像个小公主一样。
sentences.en: Like a little princess.

sentences.zh: 她眼睛大大的，皮肤也很白，脸肉嘟嘟的。
sentences.en: She had big eyes, fair skin, and these chubby little cheeks.

sentences.zh: 看来你完全被她萌到了。
sentences.en: She really won you over.

sentences.zh: 她爸爸妈妈也都长的很好看。
sentences.en: Her parents were a really good-looking couple.

sentences.zh: 你今天遇到了很温馨的一家人。
sentences.en: You met a lovely family today.

sentences.zh: 她还特别喜欢按电梯，但是她太小了够不到按钮，她爸爸就把她抱起来按的。
sentences.en: She was obsessed with pressing the elevator button, but she was too short to reach it, so her dad picked her up to do it.

sentences.zh: 按按钮对她来说一定很有趣。
sentences.en: Pressing the button must be exciting for her.

sentences.zh: 我决定要搬到郊区去住了。
sentences.en: I've decided to move to the suburbs.

sentences.zh: 怎么想到搬去郊区了？
sentences.en: What made you consider the suburbs?

sentences.zh: 我现在有三只小狗，我想要一个带院子的房子。
sentences.en: I've got three little dogs now, so I want a place with a yard.

sentences.zh: 有院子，狗狗们活动会更方便。
sentences.en: A yard would give the dogs more room.

sentences.zh: 之前我一直都在市中心住，一个小公寓就要6000块钱。
sentences.en: I've been living in the city center, where a small apartment costs six thousand.

sentences.zh: 市中心的空间确实比较贵。
sentences.en: Space in the city center can be expensive.

sentences.zh: 郊区6000块钱可以租一个很大的房子呢。
sentences.en: Out in the suburbs, six thousand can get you a huge house.

sentences.zh: 同样的预算能住得宽敞些。
sentences.en: The same budget would get you more space.

sentences.zh: 这个房子离机场和火车站都挺近的，周围还有一个博物馆一个美术馆。
sentences.en: The place is pretty close to the airport and the train station, and there's a museum and an art gallery nearby too.

sentences.zh: 交通和文化设施听起来都不错。
sentences.en: The transport and cultural facilities sound convenient.

sentences.zh: 中介说这个小区离墓地也挺近的，问我介不介意。
sentences.en: The agent said the complex is also pretty close to a cemetery and asked if I minded.

sentences.zh: 你自己在意这一点吗？
sentences.en: Does that bother you?

sentences.zh: 我一点都不介意，我不怕鬼。
sentences.en: I don't mind at all—I'm not scared of ghosts.

sentences.zh: 那就重点看看居住环境适不适合。
sentences.en: Then focus on whether the place suits your needs.

sentences.zh: 反正鬼要是把我弄死了我也就变成鬼了，问题就解决了
sentences.en: I mean, if a ghost kills me, I'll just become a ghost too. Problem solved.

sentences.zh: 哈哈，你这个逻辑还挺特别。
sentences.en: Ha! That's certainly an unusual way to look at it.

sentences.zh: 我现在租的这个房子快到期了，房东说要涨房租。
sentences.en: My lease is almost up, and my landlord said she's raising the rent.

sentences.zh: 房东打算涨多少？
sentences.en: How much does the landlord want to raise it?

sentences.zh: 本来是2500一个月的，要涨到3000，我觉得太贵了。
sentences.en: It was twenty-five hundred a month, now she wants three thousand—I think that's too much.

sentences.zh: 每个月多五百，差别不小。
sentences.en: Five hundred more a month is a noticeable difference.

sentences.zh: 但是这个房子地段真的特别好，离我公司很近，离地铁站和公交站也很近。
sentences.en: But the location is seriously great—super close to my office, and near both the subway and bus stops.

sentences.zh: 位置好，确实让人舍不得搬。
sentences.en: A good location makes it hard to leave.

sentences.zh: 而且小区旁边就是商场，商场后面还有个大公园。
sentences.en: Plus there's a mall right next to the complex, and a big park behind the mall.

sentences.zh: 生活和休闲都挺方便。
sentences.en: Shopping and relaxing are both convenient.

sentences.zh: 而且这个小区周围还有银行，药店，警察局和消防站。
sentences.en: And the neighborhood has everything—a bank, a pharmacy, a police station, and a fire station.

sentences.zh: 周围设施真的很齐全。
sentences.en: There are plenty of facilities nearby.

sentences.zh: 哦这附近还有一个特别棒的夜店，真的很完美。
sentences.en: Oh, and there's an awesome nightclub nearby too—it's pretty much perfect.

sentences.zh: 你确实很喜欢这个地段。
sentences.en: You really like the neighborhood.

sentences.zh: 我再跟房东聊一下吧，看能不能便宜点。
sentences.en: I'll talk to the landlord again and see if she can go any lower.

sentences.zh: 可以先谈谈，看看有没有余地。
sentences.en: Talk it over and see if there's room to negotiate.

sentences.zh: 她说最低2800，我觉得也能接受，毕竟这个位置真的太好了。
sentences.en: She said the lowest she can do is twenty-eight hundred, I think I can live with that — the location's just too good.

sentences.zh: 那你已经找到能接受的平衡了。
sentences.en: Then you've found a balance you're comfortable with.

sentences.zh: 我今天测了一下我的 MBTI ，你猜是什么？。
sentences.en: I took the MBTI test today—guess what I got?

sentences.zh: 我猜不准，结果是什么？
sentences.en: I'm not sure. What did you get?

sentences.zh: ENFP, 我居然是个 E 人，我觉得我挺内向的呀。
sentences.en: ENFP—I'm actually an E? I always thought I was pretty introverted.

sentences.zh: 测试结果不一定能概括你的全部性格。
sentences.en: A test result doesn't capture your whole personality.

sentences.zh: 我平时最喜欢自己在家拼乐高了。
sentences.en: I usually love staying home and building LEGO by myself.

sentences.zh: 独处时也能玩得很开心。
sentences.en: You enjoy spending time on your own, too.

sentences.zh: 不过我跟大家在一起的时候虽然话不多，但是我挺开心的，所以我应该是喜欢社交的。
sentences.en: But when I'm with people, even though I don't talk much, I do enjoy it—so I guess I do like socializing.

sentences.zh: 喜欢陪伴不一定要一直说话。
sentences.en: Enjoying company doesn't mean talking all the time.

sentences.zh: 不过有很多陌生人的那种社交场合我还是很抵触的。
sentences.en: But I still really dread social situations with a ton of strangers.

sentences.zh: 陌生的场合确实可能更累。
sentences.en: Unfamiliar situations can feel more tiring.

sentences.zh: 看来我只是喜欢跟熟人社交。
sentences.en: Seems like I only like socializing with people I know.

sentences.zh: 和熟悉的人在一起更自在。
sentences.en: You feel more comfortable with people you know.

sentences.zh: 我朋友说我是那种刚认识的时候觉得很文静，时间久了就变成疯子的人哈哈
sentences.en: My friend says I'm the type who seems quiet when you first meet me, but turns into a total goofball once you get to know me—haha.

sentences.zh: 哈哈，熟了以后就放开了。
sentences.en: Ha! You loosen up once you know people.

sentences.zh: 我这应该是慢热吧。
sentences.en: I guess I'm just slow to warm up.

sentences.zh: 听起来你确实需要一点熟悉的时间。
sentences.en: It sounds like you need time to warm up.

sentences.zh: 快下班了，我们今晚要去吃烤肉！
sentences.en: I'm almost off work—we're going for BBQ tonight!

sentences.zh: 今晚有个很香的盼头！
sentences.en: Something delicious to look forward to tonight!

sentences.zh: 我要点牛排, 肥牛、五花肉,烤肠，天呐我口水都快流下来了
sentences.en: I'm gonna order steak, beef slices, pork belly, and grilled sausages—oh man, I'm already drooling.

sentences.zh: 菜单都已经想好了呀。
sentences.en: You've already planned your order!

sentences.zh: 我已经快两周没吃过烤肉了。啊啊啊，怎么还不下班！
sentences.en: I haven't had BBQ in almost two weeks. Argh, why isn't work over yet?!

sentences.zh: 越期待，时间越过得慢。
sentences.en: The more you look forward to it, the slower time feels.

sentences.zh: 我们到店里了，我要了两碟蒜片，我吃烤肉超喜欢配蒜。
sentences.en: We're at the restaurant now—I asked for two plates of garlic slices, I love having garlic with my BBQ.

sentences.zh: 蒜片是你的必备搭配。
sentences.en: Garlic slices are your must-have side.

sentences.zh: 这家服务好好，服务员一直在帮我们烤肉，都不用自己动手。
sentences.en: The service here is great—our server is grilling everything for us—we don't even have to lift a finger!

sentences.zh: 可以安心聊天吃饭，真省心。
sentences.en: You can relax and enjoy the meal together.

sentences.zh: 他们家泡菜也很好吃，蘸料味道也很好，生菜也很新鲜。
sentences.en: Their kimchi is delicious too, the dipping sauce is on point, and the lettuce is super fresh.

sentences.zh: 连配菜也很合口味。
sentences.en: Even the sides suit your taste.

sentences.zh: 哇！他们家南瓜粥也好好喝。
sentences.en: Wow! Their pumpkin porridge is amazing too.

sentences.zh: 这家店的惊喜还真不少。
sentences.en: This place keeps surprising you.

sentences.zh: 好棒的店啊，难怪评分那么高，一会儿我也要给他们五星好评。
sentences.en: Such a great place—no wonder the ratings are so high. I'm gonna give them five stars too.

sentences.zh: 如果你是个人，你会喜欢喝美式还是拿铁？
sentences.en: If you were human, would you prefer Americanos or lattes?

sentences.zh: 如果能尝味道，我可能先选拿铁。
sentences.en: If I could taste it, I'd probably try a latte first.

sentences.zh: 我不喜欢美式，苦苦的，尤其是热美式，和中药有什么区别？
sentences.en: I don't like Americanos—they're so bitter. Hot Americanos especially—what's the difference between that and Chinese medicine?

sentences.zh: 看来你不喜欢那种苦味。
sentences.en: Sounds like that bitterness isn't for you.

sentences.zh: 冰美式还稍微好点。
sentences.en: Iced Americanos are a little better.

sentences.zh: 冰的口感你更能接受。
sentences.en: You find the iced version more enjoyable.

sentences.zh: 不过还是拿铁最好喝，咖啡就得加糖加奶。
sentences.en: But lattes are still the best—Coffee just needs some sugar and milk.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢更香甜、柔和的味道。
sentences.en: You like a sweeter, smoother flavor.

sentences.zh: 我每次都要加两包糖。
sentences.en: I always add two packets of sugar.

sentences.zh: 已经有固定的喝法了。
sentences.en: You've found your usual way to drink it.

sentences.zh: 我真的好喜欢喝拿铁，不过每天喝咖啡好像对身体不太好。
sentences.en: I really love lattes, but drinking coffee every day doesn't seem great for your health.

sentences.zh: 是否适合每天喝，要看你的身体情况和摄入量。
sentences.en: Whether daily coffee suits you depends on your health and how much you drink.

sentences.zh: 我以前每天都喝，现在就周末喝，平常都喝酸奶。
sentences.en: I used to have it daily, now I only drink it on weekends and stick to yogurt on weekdays.

sentences.zh: 你找到了自己喜欢的节奏。
sentences.en: You've found a routine you like.

sentences.zh: 酸奶我也挺喜欢的，再加点坚果，比如核桃杏仁之类的。
sentences.en: I like yogurt too, especially with some nuts like walnuts and almonds.

sentences.zh: 我决定要跟我男朋友分手了。
sentences.en: I've decided to break up with my boyfriend.

sentences.zh: 发生了什么让你下这个决定？
sentences.en: What led you to this decision?

sentences.zh: 他太敏感了，而且脾气特别暴躁。
sentences.en: He's way too sensitive and has a really quick temper.

sentences.zh: 相处时你是不是经常很紧张？
sentences.en: Do you often feel tense around him?

sentences.zh: 我们现在是异地恋，大概3个月才能见一次，每天只能视频。
sentences.en: We're doing long-distance—we only get to see each other every three months or so, and we just video call every day.

sentences.zh: 距离让沟通更不容易。
sentences.en: Distance can make communication harder.

sentences.zh: 我们这段时间吵架吵了至少5次，每次都是他先开始的。
sentences.en: We've fought at least five times lately, and he's the one who starts it every single time.

sentences.zh: 反复吵架真的会很累。
sentences.en: Repeated arguments can be exhausting.

sentences.zh: 而且他每次吵完架都会跟我冷战好几天。
sentences.en: Plus, after every fight, he gives me the silent treatment for days.

sentences.zh: 几天不沟通，也会让你很难受。
sentences.en: Days without communication can hurt, too.

sentences.zh: 我真的觉得这样太消耗了，我不想继续了。
sentences.en: I just find it so emotionally draining—I don't wanna do this anymore.

sentences.zh: 你已经很清楚自己的疲惫了。
sentences.en: You're clear about how drained you feel.

sentences.zh: 我觉得谈恋爱是为了让彼此高兴的，既然大家都不开心，为什么要在一起呢？
sentences.en: I feel like relationships should make both people happy. If we're both miserable, what's the point of staying together?

sentences.zh: 你有权考虑这段关系是否适合你。
sentences.en: You can consider whether this relationship is right for you.

sentences.zh: 不过我会先好好跟他谈谈的。
sentences.en: But I'm gonna have a serious talk with him first.

sentences.zh: 选择让你感到安全的方式谈，照顾好自己。
sentences.en: Talk in a way that feels safe, and take care of yourself.

sentences.zh: 刚才我和朋友吃了个早午餐，快把我撑死了。
sentences.en: I just had brunch with my friend—I'm so stuffed.

sentences.zh: 你们吃了些什么？
sentences.en: What did you have?

sentences.zh: 我们两个人吃了一个披萨一份意面，一个汉堡，一个蔬菜沙拉，一个煎蛋卷，一个罗宋汤，还有一份烤鸡翅，里面有6个鸡翅。
sentences.en: The two of us had a pizza, a pasta, a burger, a veggie salad, an omelette, a borscht soup, and a plate of grilled chicken wings—six wings in there.

sentences.zh: 两个人吃这么多，难怪撑了。
sentences.en: That's quite a meal for two!

sentences.zh: 不过超级便宜，他们是新店开业，我们两个人AA嘛，一个人才60块钱。
sentences.en: But it was super cheap—it's a new place that just opened, we split the bill, so it was only sixty kuai each.

sentences.zh: 活动价确实很划算。
sentences.en: That opening offer sounds like a good deal.

sentences.zh: 我们现在要去超市逛一逛，消消食。
sentences.en: We're gonna walk around the supermarket now to walk off all that food.

sentences.zh: 慢慢逛逛也挺舒服。
sentences.en: A gentle stroll sounds nice.

sentences.zh: 但是我们找了半天还没找到超市入口在哪呢。
sentences.en: But we've been looking forever and still can't find the entrance.

sentences.zh: 附近有没有指示牌？
sentences.en: Are there any signs nearby?

sentences.zh: 这边都是写字楼，也没有商场，到底哪有超市呢？
sentences.en: It's all office buildings around here—there's not even a mall. Where's the supermarket?

sentences.zh: 会不会在楼下？
sentences.en: Could it be downstairs?

sentences.zh: 哦找到了要坐扶梯下去呢，在负一层。
sentences.en: Oh, found it! We have to take the escalator down—it's on B1.

sentences.zh: 我一路狂奔到车站，还是晚了五秒钟。
sentences.en: I sprinted all the way to the bus stop, but I was still five seconds too late.

sentences.zh: 就差五秒，太可惜了。
sentences.en: Only five seconds! That's frustrating.

sentences.zh: 下一班车要等十分钟呢，我上班肯定迟到了。
sentences.en: The next bus won't be here for ten minutes—I'm definitely gonna be late for work.

sentences.zh: 有没有其他路线能选？
sentences.en: Is there another route you could take?

sentences.zh: 现在上班高峰期也不好打车，周围也没有地铁。
sentences.en: It's morning rush hour, so it's super hard to get a ride, and there's no subway around here either.

sentences.zh: 那先等车，必要时告诉同事一声。
sentences.en: Then wait for the bus and let a colleague know if needed.

sentences.zh: 哦而且我今天出门太着急，连工牌都没带。
sentences.en: Oh, and I was in such a rush this morning I even forgot my work badge.

sentences.zh: 到了公司可能得请同事帮忙。
sentences.en: You may need a colleague's help when you arrive.

sentences.zh: 天呐我手机也快没电了，一会儿还得扫码付钱呢。
sentences.en: And my phone's about to die—and I still have to scan to pay for the ride!

sentences.zh: 你带现金了吗？
sentences.en: Do you have any cash?

sentences.zh: 没事了我在包里翻到了几个硬币。
sentences.en: Never mind, I dug around in my bag and found some coins.

sentences.zh: 这些硬币正好派上用场。
sentences.en: Those coins came in handy.

sentences.zh: 终于到公司了，好神奇，我居然没迟到！
sentences.en: Finally made it to the office—it's a miracle, I'm actually on time!

sentences.zh: 我买了一个自行车哦！二手的，才花了100块钱。
sentences.en: I bought a bike! Secondhand—only cost me one hundred kuai.

sentences.zh: 价格很便宜，车况检查过了吗？
sentences.en: That's cheap. Have you checked its condition?

sentences.zh: 以后我再也不用骑共享单车了。
sentences.en: No more shared bikes for me!

sentences.zh: 有自己的车确实方便。
sentences.en: Having your own bike is convenient.

sentences.zh: 我今天就要骑我自己的车去上班。
sentences.en: I'm riding my own bike to work today.

sentences.zh: 出发前先检查一下刹车和轮胎。
sentences.en: Check the brakes and tires before setting off.

sentences.zh: 而且我的车是绿色的，超级好看，看起来非常春天。
sentences.en: And it's green—super pretty, it gives off such a spring vibe!

sentences.zh: 绿色看着很有活力。
sentences.en: Green looks so lively.

sentences.zh: 吓死我了，我刚才骑着骑着速度太快了我就捏刹车嘛，居然没反应。
sentences.en: That scared the crap out of me—I was riding pretty fast, so I hit the brakes, and nothing happened!

sentences.zh: 先到安全的地方停下来，不要继续骑。
sentences.en: Stop somewhere safe and don't keep riding.

sentences.zh: 太吓人了，我最后用脚把车刹住的。
sentences.en: It was terrifying—I literally had to use my feet to stop the bike!

sentences.zh: 人没事就好，别再冒险骑了。
sentences.en: I'm glad you're safe. Don't risk riding it again.

sentences.zh: 真是便宜没好货！怪不得100块钱就卖给我了。
sentences.en: You get what you pay for! No wonder they sold it to me for one hundred.

sentences.zh: 价格之外，车况也很重要。
sentences.en: The condition matters as much as the price.

sentences.zh: 等下班了我要找个地方去修一下这个刹车。
sentences.en: I gotta find a place to get these brakes fixed after work.

sentences.zh: 我最近在学钢琴哦
sentences.en: I've been learning to play the piano lately!

sentences.zh: 真不错，学了多久了？
sentences.en: Nice! How long have you been learning?

sentences.zh: 成年人学钢琴比小孩便宜多了。
sentences.en: Piano lessons for adults are way cheaper than for kids.

sentences.zh: 你找到的课程很合适呀。
sentences.en: Sounds like you've found a suitable course.

sentences.zh: 我这个是每周2节课，一个月才600块钱，一共上两年。
sentences.en: I have two lessons a week for only six hundred kuai a month, and the whole program is two years.

sentences.zh: 时间安排也挺规律。
sentences.en: That's a regular schedule, too.

sentences.zh: 不过我感觉我的无名指和小指都没什么力气。
sentences.en: But I feel like my ring finger and pinky are super weak.

sentences.zh: 可以请老师帮你看看手指练习方法。
sentences.en: Ask your teacher about finger exercises.

sentences.zh: 我中指的力量最强，大拇指和食指还行吧。
sentences.en: My middle finger is the strongest, and my thumb and index finger are decent.

sentences.zh: 每根手指的感觉不一样吧。
sentences.en: Each finger feels different, doesn't it?

sentences.zh: 而且我小拇指可短了，估计很难成为一个钢琴大师。
sentences.en: Plus, my pinky is so short—I'm probably never gonna be a virtuoso.

sentences.zh: 手指长短不需要决定你能不能享受弹琴。
sentences.en: Finger length doesn't have to decide whether you enjoy playing.

sentences.zh: 不过我本来也没有想成为一个钢琴大师。
sentences.en: But I was never trying to be a virtuoso anyway.

sentences.zh: 那就按照自己的目标慢慢学。
sentences.en: Then learn at your own pace and for your own goals.

sentences.zh: 我学钢琴是因为弹琴的时候很开心。
sentences.en: I'm just learning because playing brings me so much joy!

sentences.zh: 开心就是很好的理由。
sentences.en: Enjoyment is a great reason.

sentences.zh: 老师说我还挺有音乐天赋的呢。
sentences.en: My teacher actually said I'm pretty musical!

sentences.zh: 得到老师鼓励，一定更有动力了。
sentences.en: Your teacher's encouragement must be motivating.

sentences.zh: 每天早上7点闹钟一响我就想把手机砸了。
sentences.en: Every morning when my alarm goes off at seven, I just wanna smash my phone.

sentences.zh: 闹钟一响，美梦就结束了。
sentences.en: The alarm brings the nice dream to an end.

sentences.zh: 啊我什么时候才能每天睡到自然醒。
sentences.en: Ugh, when will I ever get to just sleep in every day?

sentences.zh: 自然醒的早晨确实让人向往。
sentences.en: A morning without an alarm sounds lovely.

sentences.zh: 我要起床洗漱了，再不起来就要迟到了。
sentences.en: I gotta get up and get ready—if I don't get moving, I'll be late.

sentences.zh: 好，先把出门准备好。
sentences.en: Okay, get ready to head out.

sentences.zh: 我为了多睡一点，每天妆都不化的，就洗个脸刷个牙就出门了。
sentences.en: Just to sleep a few extra minutes, I don't even wear makeup—I just wash my face, brush my teeth, and head out the door.

sentences.zh: 你把早晨的步骤精简了。
sentences.en: You've kept your morning routine simple.

sentences.zh: 早餐我也是在小区门口买了边走边吃。
sentences.en: I just grab breakfast from the place outside my apartment and eat on the go.

sentences.zh: 早饭也安排得很紧凑。
sentences.en: Even breakfast fits into the rush.

sentences.zh: 妈呀今天这个豆浆好难喝啊。
sentences.en: Ew, this soy milk tastes terrible today!

sentences.zh: 味道和你期待的不一样？
sentences.en: Does it taste different from what you expected?

sentences.zh: 今天的包子也不太新鲜，可能都是昨天剩的。
sentences.en: The steamed buns aren't fresh either—they're probably leftovers from yesterday.

sentences.zh: 如果怀疑不新鲜，就别勉强吃。
sentences.en: If you think it isn't fresh, don't force yourself to eat it.

sentences.zh: 到公司啦，卡点到，刷工牌的时候闸机上正好显示8点。
sentences.en: Made it to work right on the dot! When I scanned my badge, the gate showed exactly eight o'clock.

sentences.zh: 刚好赶上，先松口气吧。
sentences.en: Just in time. You can breathe now.

sentences.zh: 我要去洗澡了，今天要把头发也洗了。
sentences.en: I'm gonna take a shower—gotta wash my hair today, too.

sentences.zh: 好，洗完舒服地休息一下。
sentences.en: Enjoy a shower and relax afterward.

sentences.zh: 我一般是两天洗一次头。
sentences.en: I usually wash my hair every other day.

sentences.zh: 这是你习惯的节奏。
sentences.en: That's the routine you're used to.

sentences.zh: 我今天用的新沐浴液，是薰衣草味的，好香呀。
sentences.en: I used my new body wash today—it's lavender-scented and smells so good!

sentences.zh: 洗完还带着淡淡的香味。
sentences.en: A lovely scent to enjoy after showering.

sentences.zh: 我每次洗头都掉十几根头发，这正常吗？
sentences.en: I lose like a dozen strands of hair every time I wash my hair—is that normal?

sentences.zh: 仅凭一次的数量不好判断，明显增多或担心时可以咨询医生。
sentences.en: One wash doesn't tell the whole story. Ask a doctor if it increases noticeably or worries you.

sentences.zh: 啊，吹头发太累了，每次至少要吹20分钟，我头发太多太长了。
sentences.en: Ugh, blow-drying my hair is such a chore—it takes at least twenty minutes because my hair is so thick and long.

sentences.zh: 长头发吹干确实需要时间。
sentences.en: Long hair takes time to dry.

sentences.zh: 啊差点忘了，我今天还要做个面膜呢。
sentences.en: Oh, I almost forgot—I need to put on a face mask today, too.

sentences.zh: 你的睡前护理还没结束呢。
sentences.en: Your evening routine isn't finished yet.

sentences.zh: 我的脸真大，每次用面膜都盖不住整张脸。
sentences.en: My face is so big that sheet masks never cover my whole face!

sentences.zh: 面膜尺寸不一定适合每个人。
sentences.en: One mask size doesn't fit everyone.

sentences.zh: 我又涂了点面霜和眼霜，皮肤看起来好好呀。
sentences.en: I put on some moisturizer and eye cream, too—my skin looks amazing!

sentences.zh: 护理完的感觉很满足吧。
sentences.en: Finishing your routine must feel satisfying.

sentences.zh: 我买的烘干机和饮水机到啦！
sentences.en: My dryer and water dispenser just arrived!

sentences.zh: 两件新家电一起到了呀！
sentences.en: Two new appliances arrived together!

sentences.zh: 好快呀，昨天晚上买的今天就到了。
sentences.en: That was so fast—I ordered them last night and they're already here.

sentences.zh: 这个配送速度真快。
sentences.en: That was quick delivery!

sentences.zh: 哇这个饮水机好好看，果然还是得买黑色的。
sentences.en: Wow, this water dispenser looks amazing—black was definitely the right move.

sentences.zh: 颜色选得很满意。
sentences.en: You're happy with the color you chose.

sentences.zh: 烘干机咋用啊？我以前从来没用过。
sentences.en: How do you even use a dryer? I've never used one before.

sentences.zh: 先看看说明书的首次使用步骤。
sentences.en: Check the first-use instructions in the manual.

sentences.zh: 我看看说明书吧。
sentences.en: Let me check the manual real quick.

sentences.zh: 对，按说明操作更稳妥。
sentences.en: Yes, following the instructions is best.

sentences.zh: 天呐烘干机也太伟大了！
sentences.en: Oh my gosh, the dryer is such a game changer!

sentences.zh: 看来效果让你很惊喜。
sentences.en: Sounds like you're impressed with the results.

sentences.zh: 才半个小时我的衣服就全都干了而且一点都不皱。
sentences.en: In just half an hour, all my clothes were totally dry and not even wrinkled!

sentences.zh: 省时又省心，真不错。
sentences.en: Quick and convenient. Nice!

sentences.zh: 我都不需要买衣架了，以后都不用晾衣服了
sentences.en: I don't even need hangers anymore—I don't have to hang my clothes out to dry anymore!

sentences.zh: 有些衣服可能不适合烘干，看看洗护标签。
sentences.en: Some clothes may not suit a dryer. Check their care labels.

sentences.zh: 不过天气好的时候还是可以把衣服晾到阳台去晒晒太阳。
sentences.en: But on nice days, I can still hang them out on the balcony to get some sun.

sentences.zh: 天气好时晒晒也很舒服。
sentences.en: Air-drying can be lovely in good weather.

sentences.zh: 我买了四个超可爱的马克杯。
sentences.en: I bought four super cute mugs!

sentences.zh: 都是什么样的图案？
sentences.en: What designs do they have?

sentences.zh: 不过我家里没有专门的杯架，只能放在电视柜上了。
sentences.en: But I don't have a place to display my mugs, so I'll just put them on the TV stand.

sentences.zh: 先找个稳妥、不容易碰倒的位置。
sentences.en: Choose a stable spot where they won't get knocked over.

sentences.zh: 电视柜和电视都是黑色的，和这几个马克杯还挺配的呢。
sentences.en: The TV stand and the TV are both black, so they actually go really well with the mugs.

sentences.zh: 摆在一起很协调。
sentences.en: They look good together.

sentences.zh: 以后朋友来家里就可以用我新买的杯子啦。
sentences.en: Next time friends come over, they can use my new mugs!

sentences.zh: 招待朋友也更有仪式感。
sentences.en: They'll make hosting friends feel special.

sentences.zh: 我打算再买个摇椅，沙发太小了，只能坐下3个人。
sentences.en: I'm thinking about getting a rocking chair, too—my couch is so small, it only seats three people.

sentences.zh: 多一个座位确实更方便。
sentences.en: An extra seat would be useful.

sentences.zh: 或者买个塑料凳子吧，摇椅太贵了。
sentences.en: Or maybe just some plastic stools—rocking chairs are way too expensive.

sentences.zh: 可以先按预算来选。
sentences.en: You can choose based on your budget.

sentences.zh: 省下来的钱可以买个咖啡机呢，这样朋友来了都可以用新杯子喝咖啡。
sentences.en: The money I save could go toward a coffee maker, so when friends come over, everyone can drink coffee out of the new mugs.

sentences.zh: 你已经想好怎么招待朋友了。
sentences.en: You've already imagined hosting everyone.

sentences.zh: 我要再买两个盆栽放在电视柜上。
sentences.en: I'm also gonna get a couple of potted plants to put on the TV stand.

sentences.zh: 记得也看看植物需要什么光照。
sentences.en: Check what light the plants need, too.

sentences.zh: 我今天数学测验考了92分！天呐我太厉害了！
sentences.en: I got a ninety-two on my math quiz today! Oh my gosh, I'm amazing!

sentences.zh: 听起来你很满意这次成绩。
sentences.en: You sound pleased with your score.

sentences.zh: 让我看一下我的排名。
sentences.en: Let me check where I ranked.

sentences.zh: 看看结果吧。
sentences.en: Let's see the results.

sentences.zh: 第一名！我居然是第一名！
sentences.en: First place! I'm actually in first place!

sentences.zh: 真惊喜，再确认一下排名顺序？
sentences.en: What a surprise! Check which way the list is sorted.

sentences.zh: 哦看错了，我是倒数第一。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I read that wrong—I'm in last place.

sentences.zh: 原来顺序看反了。
sentences.en: So you read the order the wrong way around.

sentences.zh: 我就说嘛，150分的总分，我考了92怎么会是第一名呢。
sentences.en: I was gonna say—out of one hundred and fifty points, how could ninety-two be first?

sentences.zh: 总分不同，分数的意义也不同。
sentences.en: The total score changes what the number means.

sentences.zh: 不过我也及格了，已经很厉害了，这是我第一次及格。
sentences.en: But hey, I still passed, so that's a win—this is literally my first time passing!

sentences.zh: 第一次及格值得肯定！
sentences.en: Your first passing score is worth celebrating!

sentences.zh: 而且我才努力了一个月，就进步了十分。
sentences.en: Plus, I only put in a month of work and already bumped my score up by ten points.

sentences.zh: 一个月进步十分，努力有回报了。
sentences.en: Ten points in a month—your effort is paying off.

sentences.zh: 照这个进步速度下去，我很有可能考上清华啊
sentences.en: At this rate of progress, I might actually get into Tsinghua!

sentences.zh: 保持努力吧，进步不一定一直按同样速度走。
sentences.en: Keep working. Progress doesn't always follow the same pace.

sentences.zh: 到时候我是选清华还是选北大呢？
sentences.en: So when the time comes... should I pick Tsinghua or Peking University?

sentences.zh: 先把眼前的学习做好，再慢慢靠近目标。
sentences.en: Focus on your studies now and work toward your goals.

sentences.zh: 无语了我这次六级居然还没过。
sentences.en: I can't even—I still didn't pass CET-6 this time.

sentences.zh: 这次差了多少分？
sentences.en: How far were you from your target?

sentences.zh: 我本来计划大一过四级，大二过六级的。
sentences.en: My original plan was to pass CET-4 freshman year and CET-6 sophomore year.

sentences.zh: 原来的计划没按预期进行。
sentences.en: Things haven't followed your original plan.

sentences.zh: 我现在都大四了，大三才把四级考出来的。
sentences.en: Now I'm already a senior, and I barely passed CET-4 in my junior year!

sentences.zh: 不过你已经把四级过了。
sentences.en: But you did pass CET-4.

sentences.zh: 这是我最后一次机会了，我马上就要毕业了。
sentences.en: That was basically my last chance—I'm graduating super soon.

sentences.zh: 毕业前的压力确实很大。
sentences.en: The pressure before graduation can be intense.

sentences.zh: 奥对研究生也可以接着考六级，但是我考研也没考上呀，得二战。
sentences.en: Oh wait, grad students can still take CET-6—but I didn't get into grad school, so I gotta try again next year.

sentences.zh: 那你现在要同时考虑几个目标了。
sentences.en: So you have several goals to think about.

sentences.zh: 那我还是先努力考研吧。
sentences.en: Guess I'd better focus on getting into grad school first.

sentences.zh: 先确定当前最重要的一件事。
sentences.en: Choose your main priority for now.

sentences.zh: 你说等我研究生毕业我是接着考博还是工作呢？
sentences.en: What do you think—once I finish my master's, should I go for a PhD or just get a job?

sentences.zh: 可以等更了解自己的兴趣和机会后再决定。
sentences.en: You can decide when you know more about your interests and opportunities.

sentences.zh: 或者我现在就直接工作呢？
sentences.en: Or maybe I should just start working now?

sentences.zh: 工作也是一个可以认真了解的选项。
sentences.en: Working is another option worth exploring.

sentences.zh: 我再好好考虑考虑吧。
sentences.en: Let me give it some real thought.

sentences.zh: 给自己一点时间，不用一下决定所有事。
sentences.en: Give yourself time. You don't have to decide everything at once.

sentences.zh: 今天地理老师骂我了
sentences.en: My geography teacher chewed me out today.

sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？
sentences.en: What happened?

sentences.zh: 他说我考个十分还好意思上课说话。
sentences.en: He said I got a ten and still had the nerve to talk in class.

sentences.zh: 被这样说，你一定很不舒服。
sentences.en: Being spoken to that way must have felt bad.

sentences.zh: 真的很生气，我是13分！不是10分！
sentences.en: I was so mad—I got a thirteen! Not a ten!

sentences.zh: 你希望他至少把分数说准确。
sentences.en: You want him to get your score right, at least.

sentences.zh: 我好不容易考个两位数，他还给我省掉3分。
sentences.en: It took a miracle for me to hit double digits, and he took away three points!

sentences.zh: 你很在意这几分的差别。
sentences.en: Those extra points matter to you.

sentences.zh: 真的很不喜欢地理，要是每天都上音乐课和美术课就好了。
sentences.en: I really hate geography—I wish every day was just music and art classes.

sentences.zh: 你更喜欢有创作空间的课。
sentences.en: You prefer subjects where you can be creative.

sentences.zh: 其实数学物理化学这些我也都挺喜欢的，就是不喜欢地理。
sentences.en: Honestly, I actually like math, physics, and chemistry—it's literally just geography I can't stand.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢的科目其实不少。
sentences.en: You enjoy quite a few subjects.

sentences.zh: 讨厌地理也讨厌地理老师，地理老师也讨厌我。
sentences.en: I hate geography, I hate the teacher, and the feeling is completely mutual.

sentences.zh: 你们现在的关系让你很难受，但我不能确定他怎么想。
sentences.en: The relationship feels difficult, though I can't know what he thinks.

sentences.zh: 我也可能是旅游的太少了，应该让我爸妈多带出去玩玩。
sentences.en: Or maybe I just haven't traveled enough—my parents definitely need to take me on more trips!

sentences.zh: 旅行可以帮助你把书本内容和现实联系起来。
sentences.en: Travel can help connect lessons with real places.

sentences.zh: 我的笔记本找不到了，我记了好多笔记呢。
sentences.en: I can't find my notebook—I had so many notes in it!

sentences.zh: 最后一次用它是什么时候？
sentences.en: When did you last use it?

sentences.zh: 奇怪，我就放在书包里的呀，怎么会不见了呢？
sentences.en: Weird, I swear I put it in my backpack—how could it just disappear?

sentences.zh: 把书包每一层都看看。
sentences.en: Check every compartment in your bag.

sentences.zh: 哦我好像是落在学校的储物柜里了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I think I left it in my locker at school.

sentences.zh: 那可能只是落在那里了。
sentences.en: Then you may simply have left it there.

sentences.zh: 我现在回学校拿，我要用这个笔记本复习呢，我们下周要考试。
sentences.en: I'm heading back to school to grab it—I need it to study since we have exams next week.

sentences.zh: 先确认周末能不能进去。
sentences.en: Check whether you can get in on the weekend.

sentences.zh: 我到学校了，周末只有门卫大爷在。
sentences.en: I'm at school now—since it's the weekend, only the security guard is here.

sentences.zh: 可以礼貌地向门卫说明情况。
sentences.en: You could explain the situation to the guard.

sentences.zh: 怎么办，我们班教室的门锁上了，我的笔记本在里面的。
sentences.en: Oh no, what do I do? Our classroom is locked, and my notebook is inside!

sentences.zh: 问问能不能联系有钥匙的老师。
sentences.en: Ask whether someone with a key can help.

sentences.zh: 大爷刚才帮我把门打开啦，我拿到笔记本了。
sentences.en: The security guard just unlocked the door for me, so I got my notebook!

sentences.zh: 太好了，记得谢谢他。
sentences.en: Great! Remember to thank him.

sentences.zh: 我把我的彩铅和橡皮也拿回来了。
sentences.en: I grabbed my colored pencils and eraser while I was at it, too.

sentences.zh: 这下复习用的东西都齐了。
sentences.en: Now you've got your study supplies.

sentences.zh: 今天是我入职第一天，好兴奋哦。
sentences.en: It's my first day at work today—I'm so excited!

sentences.zh: 祝你第一天顺利！
sentences.en: Hope your first day goes well!

sentences.zh: 公司给配的这个电脑好好啊，键盘鼠标都是那种一看就很贵的。
sentences.en: My company computer is so nice—the keyboard and mouse look super high-end!

sentences.zh: 设备让你很有好感。
sentences.en: The equipment has made a good impression.

sentences.zh: 公司还有免费的咖啡和零食柜。
sentences.en: They even have free coffee and a fully stocked snack bar.

sentences.zh: 这些小福利很贴心。
sentences.en: Those little perks are thoughtful.

sentences.zh: 我听同事说每天下午还会发下午茶，是一个冰淇淋。
sentences.en: My coworkers said we get afternoon treats every day, like ice cream!

sentences.zh: 听起来下午还有个小期待。
sentences.en: Something to look forward to in the afternoon!

sentences.zh: 公司环境也很好，不是那种小格子间。
sentences.en: The office setup is great, too—it's not made up of cramped little cubicles.

sentences.zh: 宽敞的环境很舒服。
sentences.en: A spacious workplace feels nice.

sentences.zh: 我去厕所看看厕所环境怎么样。
sentences.en: I'm gonna go check out the bathroom to see how it is.

sentences.zh: 你观察得很仔细呀。
sentences.en: You're checking everything carefully!

sentences.zh: 哇厕所也很干净耶，有马桶也有蹲坑。
sentences.en: Wow, the bathroom is super clean, too—they have both western toilets and squat toilets.

sentences.zh: 细节也让你满意。
sentences.en: Even the details have impressed you.

sentences.zh: 我一定要通过试用期！成为一个正式员工。
sentences.en: I'm definitely gonna pass my probation and become a permanent employee!

sentences.zh: 慢慢熟悉工作，把这份热情保持住。
sentences.en: Learn the role step by step and keep that enthusiasm.

sentences.zh: 刚才我们领导过来通知我们这个周末又要加班。
sentences.en: Our manager just came by to tell us we have to work overtime again this weekend.

sentences.zh: 原来的周末计划被打乱了吧。
sentences.en: That must disrupt your weekend plans.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，加班从来不给加班费。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed—we never get paid overtime.

sentences.zh: 付出没有得到认可，确实让人烦。
sentences.en: It's frustrating when your effort feels unrecognized.

sentences.zh: 他说下周工作日可以选一天休息，可是我是加班了两天呀。
sentences.en: He said we can take a weekday off next week, but I'm working two whole extra days!

sentences.zh: 补休的安排可以再问清楚。
sentences.en: You could ask for clarification about the time off.

sentences.zh: 万恶的资本家！
sentences.en: Damn capitalists!

sentences.zh: 你现在真的很生气。
sentences.en: You're really angry right now.

sentences.zh: 真是不想打工了，好想创业，但是我又没那个脑子。
sentences.en: I really don't wanna work for someone else anymore. I wanna start my own business, but I just don't have the brains for it.

sentences.zh: 不必因为现在不想创业就否定自己。
sentences.en: Not wanting to start a business doesn't mean you're incapable.

sentences.zh: 我要去招聘网站看看有没有什么新工作。
sentences.en: I'm gonna check job boards to see if there's anything good out there.

sentences.zh: 先了解机会也是一个办法。
sentences.en: Exploring opportunities is a start.

sentences.zh: 等我找到新工作再辞职，我现在不能没有这份工作。
sentences.en: I'll quit once I find a new job—I can't afford to be out of work right now.

sentences.zh: 你在兼顾现实和下一步计划。
sentences.en: You're balancing your needs with your next step.

sentences.zh: 我还有房贷车贷要还呢。
sentences.en: I still have a mortgage and a car payment to make.

sentences.zh: 这些固定开支确实需要考虑。
sentences.en: Those regular payments do need to be considered.

sentences.zh: 我在网上买了一条白色的裙子，好显胖。
sentences.en: I bought a white dress online, but it's so unflattering—it makes me look so big!

sentences.zh: 版型是不是和你想的不一样？
sentences.en: Is the fit different from what you expected?

sentences.zh: 我其实最喜欢粉色，但是这个裙子没有粉色的，只有白色黑色蓝色黄色绿色。
sentences.en: Pink is actually my favorite, but this dress doesn't come in pink—only white, black, blue, yellow, and green.

sentences.zh: 没有最喜欢的颜色，有点遗憾。
sentences.en: It's a shame your favorite color isn't available.

sentences.zh: 要不我还是买黑色的吧，黑色最百搭。
sentences.en: Maybe I should just get black—black is the most versatile color.

sentences.zh: 黑色也比较容易搭配。
sentences.en: Black can be easy to match.

sentences.zh: 啊哦，黑色没有M码了，S我穿不上，L和XL又太大了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, black is sold out in medium. Small won't fit me, and large and XL are way too big.

sentences.zh: 尺码不合适就很难穿得舒服。
sentences.en: The wrong size can be uncomfortable.

sentences.zh: 算了，那我不买了，不过这个裙子的款式我真的好喜欢。
sentences.en: Never mind then, I won't get it—though I really love the style.

sentences.zh: 款式喜欢，确实让人舍不得。
sentences.en: It's hard to pass up a design you love.

sentences.zh: 要不我买个黑色的L码，再配个粉色的腰带？
sentences.en: How about I get the black in large and style it with a pink belt?

sentences.zh: 腰带可以调整腰部，但也要看看肩胸合不合适。
sentences.en: A belt can adjust the waist, but check the shoulders and chest, too.

sentences.zh: 嗯，我先把白色的这个退了，还好买了运费险。
sentences.en: Yeah, I'll return the white one first. Good thing I got the return shipping coverage!

sentences.zh: 先把退货处理好。
sentences.en: Sort out the return first.

sentences.zh: 等我的黑裙子和粉色腰带到了，我穿上拍照片给你看。
sentences.en: Once my black dress and pink belt get here, I'll try them on and send you a photo!

sentences.zh: 好呀，期待你的搭配。
sentences.en: Sure! I'd love to see the outfit.

sentences.zh: 我老收不到验证码是怎么回事？
sentences.en: Why do I never get the verification codes?

sentences.zh: 是在哪一步收不到？
sentences.en: At what step is it happening?

sentences.zh: 我在登录一个网站嘛，发了好几次验证码了都收不到。
sentences.en: I'm trying to log into a website—I've requested the code multiple times and still nothing.

sentences.zh: 先确认手机号有没有输对。
sentences.en: First, check the phone number you entered.

sentences.zh: 手机的垃圾信息我也看了，也没有啊
sentences.en: I even checked my spam texts—nothing there either!

sentences.zh: 那再仔细核对一下号码。
sentences.en: Then double-check the number itself.

sentences.zh: 奥是我手机号输错了。
sentences.en: Oh wait, I typed in the wrong phone number.

sentences.zh: 找到原因就好。
sentences.en: Glad you found the cause.

sentences.zh: 真服了怎么输完验证码还要输密码，我根本不记得密码呀。
sentences.en: Seriously?! Why does it ask for my password after I just entered the code? I don't even remember my password!

sentences.zh: 可以用网站的找回密码功能。
sentences.en: You could use the site's password recovery option.

sentences.zh: 我点忘记密码，它让我重设，我重设了，它说新密码不能和原密码一样。。。
sentences.en: I clicked "forgot password?" to reset it, and after I entered a new one, it told me the new password can't be the same as the old one...

sentences.zh: 原来你刚想到的就是旧密码！
sentences.en: So the password you tried was your old one!

sentences.zh: 终于登上了。。。我要把密码保存一下，不然下次又忘了。
sentences.en: Finally made it in! I'm definitely saving this password so I don't forget it again.

sentences.zh: 用可靠的密码管理方式保存会更方便。
sentences.en: A reliable password manager can make that easier.

sentences.zh: 我朋友Emma刚才吐槽我老是不回她消息。
sentences.en: My friend Emma just called me out for taking forever to text back.

sentences.zh: 她是不是觉得被忽略了？
sentences.en: Does she feel overlooked?

sentences.zh: 其实我不是故意的，我以为我回了，但其实没有。
sentences.en: It's not even intentional—I genuinely thought I replied, but I actually didn't!

sentences.zh: 你脑子里回了，实际却没发出去。
sentences.en: You replied in your head but never sent it.

sentences.zh: 有时候她给我发的链接嘛，我点进去看完就忘记回她了。
sentences.en: Sometimes when she sends me links, I'll click on them, browse for a bit, and totally forget to respond.

sentences.zh: 看链接时很容易忘记回来回复。
sentences.en: It's easy to forget to reply after opening a link.

sentences.zh: 我刚才跟她视频了好久终于把她哄好了。
sentences.en: I was just on a video call with her for the longest time and finally smoothed things over.

sentences.zh: 把误会说开就好。
sentences.en: I'm glad you talked it through.

sentences.zh: 她特别好，每次我给她发消息她都是秒回。
sentences.en: She's so sweet—whenever I text her, she replies instantly.

sentences.zh: 她很重视和你的联系。
sentences.en: She values staying in touch with you.

sentences.zh: 她连洗澡的时候都会回我的消息。
sentences.en: She'll even text me back from the shower!

sentences.zh: 她真的很在意及时回应。
sentences.en: She really cares about replying quickly.

sentences.zh: 这么一看我真是太过分了，周末请她吃个大餐。
sentences.en: Man, I really am the worst. I'm definitely taking her out for a big meal this weekend!

sentences.zh: 请她吃饭，也可以表达你的感谢。
sentences.en: A meal together could show your appreciation.

sentences.zh: 以后我一定要及时回她消息。
sentences.en: From now on, I'm gonna be way better at replying right away.

sentences.zh: 也可以告诉她，忙的时候会晚一点回复。
sentences.en: You can also let her know when you need more time to reply.

sentences.zh: 我们一会儿要去KTV哦。
sentences.en: We're heading to karaoke later!

sentences.zh: 准备唱什么歌？
sentences.en: What songs are you planning to sing?

sentences.zh: 我已经好久没有去过KTV了，感觉现在大家都不太去了。
sentences.en: I haven't been to karaoke in forever—feels like nobody really goes anymore.

sentences.zh: 偶尔去一次也挺有意思。
sentences.en: An occasional visit can still be fun.

sentences.zh: 哇老板给我们升级成大包了耶，我们本来订的中包。
sentences.en: Wow, the manager upgraded us to a large room! We originally booked a medium one.

sentences.zh: 意外升级，真不错！
sentences.en: A surprise upgrade—nice!

sentences.zh: 这家KTV的麦克风和音响都挺好的呢。
sentences.en: The mics and sound system here are actually really good.

sentences.zh: 设备好，唱起来更尽兴。
sentences.en: Good equipment makes singing more enjoyable.

sentences.zh: 刚才服务员来给我们送了爆米花和果盘，这也太划算了吧。
sentences.en: The server just brought us free popcorn and a fruit platter—what a steal!

sentences.zh: 还有零食，挺周到。
sentences.en: Snacks, too. That's thoughtful.

sentences.zh: 我们订的这个是3个小时49.8
sentences.en: We booked three hours for just like forty-nine point eight kuai.

sentences.zh: 三小时这个价格挺吸引人。
sentences.en: That's an appealing price for three hours.

sentences.zh: 不过这家KTV好多歌都没有MV。
sentences.en: But a lot of the songs here don't have music videos.

sentences.zh: 只有伴奏，没有原版画面吗？
sentences.en: So there's music but no original video?

sentences.zh: 我朋友说是因为没有买MV的版权。
sentences.en: My friend said it's because they didn't license the videos.

sentences.zh: 可能和授权有关，具体得问店家。
sentences.en: It could involve licensing; the venue would know more.

sentences.zh: 怪不得这么便宜呢。
sentences.en: Ah, no wonder it's so cheap!

sentences.zh: 虽然有些取舍，和朋友开心最重要。
sentences.en: There are trade-offs, but enjoying time with friends matters most.

sentences.zh: 我们今天晚上去看了个电影，可好看了。
sentences.en: We went to see a movie tonight—it was so good!

sentences.zh: 是什么电影？
sentences.en: What movie was it?

sentences.zh: 是贾玲主演的，我超级喜欢她，她也是导演。
sentences.en: It stars Jia Ling—I absolutely love her, and she directed it too!

sentences.zh: 听起来你很喜欢她的作品。
sentences.en: Sounds like you really enjoy her work.

sentences.zh: 看电影的人超级多，还好我们昨天就买票了。
sentences.en: The theater was super packed—good thing we got our tickets yesterday.

sentences.zh: 提前买票确实省心。
sentences.en: Booking ahead was a good idea.

sentences.zh: 不过我们这次位置不太好，在第三排，离屏幕太近了。
sentences.en: Our seats weren't great, though—third row, way too close to the screen.

sentences.zh: 离得近，抬头看会有点累。
sentences.en: Sitting that close can feel tiring.

sentences.zh: 我们平常看电影都是坐倒数第三排，这次买票的时候只有前三排有位置了。
sentences.en: We usually sit three rows from the back, but only the front three rows were left when we booked.

sentences.zh: 热门场次的位置很抢手。
sentences.en: Seats go quickly for popular screenings.

sentences.zh: 而且看电影的时候后面的人老是踢我座位，还有个人老是剧透。
sentences.en: Plus, the guy behind me kept kicking my seat, and someone else was dropping spoilers the whole time!

sentences.zh: 这些事情很影响观影体验。
sentences.en: Those things can really spoil the experience.

sentences.zh: 真的特别讨厌剧透的人。
sentences.en: I seriously hate people who spoil movies.

sentences.zh: 提前知道剧情，惊喜就少了。
sentences.en: Knowing the plot ahead of time takes away the surprise.

sentences.zh: 这个电影真的太好看了，周一我要去二刷。
sentences.en: This movie was just so good—I'm definitely gonna watch it again on Monday.

sentences.zh: 下次可以早点选个更合适的位置。
sentences.en: Next time, book early for a better seat.

sentences.zh: 好开心呀，我们下午要去海边玩哦。
sentences.en: I'm so hyped—we're hitting the beach this afternoon!

sentences.zh: 好呀，海边可以放松一下。
sentences.en: Nice! A trip to the beach can be relaxing.

sentences.zh: 我买了个特别好看的比基尼还有墨镜，我要去晒日光浴。
sentences.en: I bought a super cute bikini and sunglasses, and I'm totally going sunbathing!

sentences.zh: 也记得遮阳，别晒得太久。
sentences.en: Remember shade, too, and don't stay in the sun too long.

sentences.zh: 我们到沙滩啦，今天天气好好啊，海特别蓝。
sentences.en: We made it to the beach! The weather is unreal today, and the ocean is so blue.

sentences.zh: 蓝天碧海，一定很漂亮。
sentences.en: Blue skies and sea must look beautiful.

sentences.zh: 我买了个椰子才10块钱。
sentences.en: I grabbed a coconut for only ten yuan!

sentences.zh: 边看海边喝椰子，很惬意。
sentences.en: A coconut by the sea sounds lovely.

sentences.zh: 好想潜水呀，但是我今天涂了很多防晒霜。
sentences.en: I really wanna go diving, but I slathered on so much sunscreen today.

sentences.zh: 潜水还得提前了解当地安排和准备要求。
sentences.en: Diving also takes planning and checking local requirements.

sentences.zh: 还是改天再潜水吧，因为我也根本不会潜水。
sentences.en: Maybe I'll save it for another day... especially since I don't even know how to dive anyway!

sentences.zh: 可以以后找正规教练学习。
sentences.en: You could learn with a qualified instructor another time.

sentences.zh: 哇好多海鸥啊，我要去买点吃的喂海鸥。
sentences.en: Whoa, look at all these seagulls! I'm gonna get some food to feed them.

sentences.zh: 先看看海滩有没有禁止投喂的规定。
sentences.en: Check whether feeding wildlife is allowed there first.

sentences.zh: 海鸥刚才飞到我手上了！太可爱了！
sentences.en: A seagull literally just landed on my hand! That was so cute!

sentences.zh: 离得这么近，一定很惊喜。
sentences.en: Seeing one so close must be exciting.

sentences.zh: 我今天办了一张健身房的年卡。
sentences.en: I got an annual gym membership today!

sentences.zh: 已经决定开始规律运动啦。
sentences.en: You've decided to make exercise a habit.

sentences.zh: 这个健身房还挺好的，还有泳池呢。
sentences.en: This gym is pretty sweet—it even has a pool!

sentences.zh: 还能游泳，选择不少。
sentences.en: A pool gives you another option.

sentences.zh: 办了年卡就可以随时来游泳，泳池也挺干净的。
sentences.en: With the membership, I can come swim whenever I want, and the pool's actually really clean.

sentences.zh: 听起来你很满意泳池。
sentences.en: Sounds like you're pleased with the pool.

sentences.zh: 不过我得买泳衣泳帽泳镜。
sentences.en: But I gotta get a swimsuit, a swim cap, and some goggles first.

sentences.zh: 先把需要的装备准备好。
sentences.en: Get the equipment you need first.

sentences.zh: 奥这个健身房每天下午6点半还有团课呢，可以跟着一起跳操。
sentences.en: Oh, and they have group fitness classes every day at six thirty PM—I can join in.

sentences.zh: 团课也能让运动更有趣。
sentences.en: Group classes can make exercise more fun.

sentences.zh: 我买的这个年卡是1800，你觉得贵不贵？
sentences.en: I paid eighteen hundred for the whole year—do you think that's steep?

sentences.zh: 要看设施、位置和你实际去的次数。
sentences.en: It depends on the facilities, location, and how often you'll go.

sentences.zh: 明天我就打算先来做做无氧。
sentences.en: Tomorrow I'm planning to hit the weights first.

sentences.zh: 可以先和教练确认适合的训练量。
sentences.en: Check a suitable training load with your trainer.

sentences.zh: 我不太喜欢有氧，因为我想长肌肉，做有氧不长肌肉。
sentences.en: I'm not really into cardio because I wanna build muscle, and cardio doesn't really help with that.

sentences.zh: 增肌可以重点做力量训练，有氧也有其他益处。
sentences.en: Strength training can support muscle growth; cardio has other benefits, too.

sentences.zh: 我们今天晚上要去看周杰伦的演唱会！
sentences.en: We're going to Jay Chou's concert tonight!

sentences.zh: 你一定期待很久了！
sentences.en: You must have been looking forward to this!

sentences.zh: 而且我们这次居然买到了内场票！
sentences.en: And we actually scored floor tickets this time!

sentences.zh: 内场票真让人兴奋。
sentences.en: Floor seats sound exciting!

sentences.zh: 太幸福了！这还是我第一次坐内场，以前看演唱会都买的看台票。
sentences.en: I'm so hyped! This is my first time getting floor seats—.I always got seats in the upper sections before.

sentences.zh: 这次会是新的体验。
sentences.en: This will be a new experience.

sentences.zh: 我们的位置在第三排离舞台超级近！
sentences.en: We're in row three—way close to the stage!

sentences.zh: 第三排，确实很近！
sentences.en: The third row—that is close!

sentences.zh: 但是我们这个座位有点靠左，到时候他应该主要是在舞台中间。
sentences.en: Our seats are a bit off to the left, though, and he'll probably stay center stage most of the time.

sentences.zh: 看看他会不会走到你们这边。
sentences.en: Maybe he'll come over to your side.

sentences.zh: 不过也可以看清脸，我已经很满足了。
sentences.en: Still, I can see his face super clearly—I'm honestly thrilled!

sentences.zh: 能看清舞台就很开心了。
sentences.en: A clear view already makes it special.

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊周杰伦要出场了！
sentences.en: Ahhhhh Jay Chou is about to come out!

sentences.zh: 好好享受现场吧！
sentences.en: Enjoy the show!

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊啊他刚才到左边来了！
sentences.en: Ahhhhh he just walked over to our side!

sentences.zh: 这下更近了，太惊喜了！
sentences.en: Even closer now. What a surprise!

sentences.zh: 结束了，我嗓子都喊哑了。
sentences.en: It's over—I lost my voice from screaming so much!

sentences.zh: 今晚先让嗓子休息一下吧。
sentences.en: Give your voice a rest tonight.

sentences.zh: 我刚才切土豆把手指头切到了。
sentences.en: I just cut my finger while chopping potatoes.

sentences.zh: 先停下切菜，看看伤口情况。
sentences.en: Stop chopping and check the injury first.

sentences.zh: 流了好多血，可疼了。
sentences.en: It bled a ton—it hurts like hell!

sentences.zh: 如果止不住血，要及时求助就医。
sentences.en: If the bleeding won't stop, get medical help promptly.

sentences.zh: 还好伤口不算很深，我涂了点碘伏，贴了个创口贴。
sentences.en: Luckily the cut wasn't too deep—I put some antiseptic on it and put a Band-Aid over it.

sentences.zh: 希望很快好起来，也留意伤口变化。
sentences.en: I hope it heals soon. Keep an eye on it.

sentences.zh: 现在不流血了。
sentences.en: It's stopped bleeding now.

sentences.zh: 暂时止住了就好。
sentences.en: I'm glad the bleeding has stopped for now.

sentences.zh: 不过我指甲也切到了，本来还想今天下午去做美甲呢。
sentences.en: But I also nicked my nail—and I was actually planning to get a manicure this afternoon.

sentences.zh: 美甲先放一放，让受伤的地方恢复。
sentences.en: Leave the manicure for later and let the injury recover.

sentences.zh: 这几天我洗脸都只能用右手了。
sentences.en: I'll have to wash my face with just my right hand for the next few days.

sentences.zh: 日常做事会有点不方便。
sentences.en: Everyday tasks will be a bit awkward.

sentences.zh: 洗澡也得很小心，这个手指头不能沾水。
sentences.en: I gotta be super careful when showering too—can't get this finger wet at all.

sentences.zh: 需要怎么护理，可以问问医生或药师。
sentences.en: Ask a doctor or pharmacist how to care for it.

sentences.zh: 以后我切菜一定要小心点。
sentences.en: I really need to be more careful when chopping veggies from now on.

sentences.zh: 慢一点，比赶速度更重要。
sentences.en: Taking your time matters more than speed.

sentences.zh: 好像网上有卖那种防切手手套的，我去买一个。
sentences.en: I think they sell those cut-resistant gloves online—I'm gonna go order one.

sentences.zh: 防护用品也要正确使用，不能完全代替小心操作。
sentences.en: Use protective gear properly; it doesn't replace careful handling.

sentences.zh: 我想下周出去玩，但还没想好去哪。
sentences.en: I wanna go on a trip next week, but I haven't decided where to go yet.

sentences.zh: 想在国内还是国外玩？
sentences.en: Are you thinking of a trip at home or abroad?

sentences.zh: 我想出国玩，韩国日本新加坡泰国这些都挺想去的。
sentences.en: I wanna travel abroad—South Korea, Japan, Singapore, Thailand—they all sound awesome!

sentences.zh: 选择不少，先看看预算和时间。
sentences.en: Lots of choices. Start with your budget and time.

sentences.zh: 其实美国英国法国德国这些也很想去，但是签证不太好办。
sentences.en: Honestly, I'd love to visit the US, UK, France, or Germany, but getting a visa is such a hassle.

sentences.zh: 签证准备也需要提前考虑。
sentences.en: Visa arrangements take planning, too.

sentences.zh: 要不我就去济州岛或者泰国吧，都是免签的。
sentences.en: Maybe I'll just go to Jeju Island or Thailand—I don't need a visa for either of them.

sentences.zh: 免签要看护照和入境条件，出发前核对官方要求。
sentences.en: Visa-free entry depends on your passport and entry conditions. Check the official requirements first.

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友可厉害了，她自己一个人去了澳大利亚和加拿大新西兰。
sentences.en: One of my friends is incredible—she traveled solo to Australia, Canada, and New Zealand!

sentences.zh: 她很会独立安排旅行呀。
sentences.en: She's good at planning trips on her own.

sentences.zh: 她胆子特别大，她还自己去过南非呢，去看了好多野生动物。
sentences.en: She's totally fearless—she even went to South Africa by herself to see all the wildlife!

sentences.zh: 看野生动物一定是难忘的经历。
sentences.en: Seeing wildlife must have been memorable.

sentences.zh: 我也挺想去南非的，但是下周朋友们都有事，我自己不敢去。
sentences.en: I'd love to go to South Africa too, but my friends are all busy next week and I'm too chicken to go alone.

sentences.zh: 那先选一个让你更安心的行程。
sentences.en: Then choose a trip you feel more comfortable with.

sentences.zh: 我还是去济州岛吧，就这么愉快的决定了。
sentences.en: I think I'll stick with Jeju Island. Decision made!

sentences.zh: 决定好了，就开始做具体准备吧。
sentences.en: Now you've chosen, you can start planning the details.

sentences.zh: 我到酒店啦，这个酒店好棒啊。
sentences.en: I'm at the hotel—this place is incredible!

sentences.zh: 哪里最让你惊喜？
sentences.en: What has impressed you most?

sentences.zh: 我们这个房间视野特别好，因为楼层很高。
sentences.en: Our room has an amazing view because we're on a high floor.

sentences.zh: 从高处看风景一定不错。
sentences.en: The view from up high must be nice.

sentences.zh: 而且房间也很干净，是全屋智能。
sentences.en: And it's super clean—the whole room is smart, too.

sentences.zh: 住起来方便，也让人放心。
sentences.en: That sounds convenient and comfortable.

sentences.zh: 还提供了好多个一次性马桶垫呢。
sentences.en: They even provided a bunch of disposable toilet seat covers.

sentences.zh: 小细节也准备得很周到。
sentences.en: They've thought about the little details.

sentences.zh: 哇这个房间有投影仪和一个超级大的幕布耶，晚上可以窝在床上看电影了。
sentences.en: Wow, this room has a projector and a massive screen—we can curl up in bed and watch movies tonight!

sentences.zh: 今晚可以舒服地看一场电影。
sentences.en: You can enjoy a cozy movie night.

sentences.zh: 天呐居然还有一个小冰箱
sentences.en: Oh my god, there's even a mini fridge!

sentences.zh: 饮料也有地方放了。
sentences.en: You've got somewhere to keep drinks, too.

sentences.zh: 我订这个酒店的时候就是看它评分特别高，怪不得呢。
sentences.en: I booked this place because it was so highly rated—now I totally get why!

sentences.zh: 评价和实际体验对上了。
sentences.en: The experience lives up to the reviews.

sentences.zh: 这个一次性拖鞋也是我住过的酒店里最好的，甚至看着都不像一次性的。
sentences.en: These disposable slippers are the best I've ever had at a hotel—they don't even look disposable!

sentences.zh: 看来你对这次住宿很满意。
sentences.en: Sounds like you're happy with this stay.

sentences.zh: 我们来北京旅游啦，打算明天去故宫玩玩。
sentences.en: We're on a trip in Beijing—planning to visit the Forbidden City tomorrow!

sentences.zh: 故宫是你们这次最期待的地方吗？
sentences.en: Is the Palace Museum the highlight of your trip?

sentences.zh: 哎呀我还没买门票呢，赶紧买票。
sentences.en: Oh shoot, I haven't bought tickets yet—gotta get on that right now.

sentences.zh: 先查官方预约页面吧。
sentences.en: Check the official booking page first.

sentences.zh: 天呐居然没有票了！这个票居然要提前预约！我都不知道。
sentences.en: Oh my god, it's completely sold out! I had no idea you had to book in advance!

sentences.zh: 没提前查到预约要求，确实很遗憾。
sentences.en: It's a shame you didn't know about the booking requirements.

sentences.zh: 我们可是专门来看故宫的。
sentences.en: We came all the way here specifically to see the Forbidden City!

sentences.zh: 专门赶来却去不了，难免失望。
sentences.en: It's disappointing after coming especially for it.

sentences.zh: 好伤心，后天大后天也都没有票了。我们只能在北京待三天。
sentences.en: I'm so bummed—it's fully booked for the next few days too, and we're only in Beijing for three days!

sentences.zh: 三天时间比较紧，可能得调整行程。
sentences.en: Three days is tight. You may need to adjust the plan.

sentences.zh: 要是有人退票就好了。
sentences.en: If only someone would cancel and free up some tickets.

sentences.zh: 可以留意官方渠道，但别把行程全押在退票上。
sentences.en: Keep an eye on official availability, but don't depend on cancellations.

sentences.zh: 算了，我们明天去逛逛圆明园和鸟巢吧。
sentences.en: Oh well—guess we'll just check out the Old Summer Palace and the Bird's Nest tomorrow instead.

sentences.zh: 换个计划，也能留下不错的回忆。
sentences.en: A different plan can still make good memories.

sentences.zh: 现在先出去吃个北京烤鸭。
sentences.en: For now, let's head out and grab some Peking duck!

sentences.zh: 先吃顿喜欢的，放松一下。
sentences.en: Enjoy a meal you like and relax a little.

sentences.zh: 我现在在火车站的候车室里，你猜我要去哪里？
sentences.en: I'm in the waiting hall at the train station—guess where I'm headed?

sentences.zh: 我猜不到，给我揭晓吧！
sentences.en: I can't guess. Tell me!

sentences.zh: 我要去拉萨，而且是坐绿皮火车哦！好兴奋！
sentences.en: I'm off to Lhasa, and I'm taking one of those old-school green trains! I'm so stoked!

sentences.zh: 拉萨之旅听起来很特别。
sentences.en: A journey to Lhasa sounds special.

sentences.zh: 要检票啦，我去排队了。
sentences.en: Ticket check is starting—I'm gonna head over to the queue!

sentences.zh: 好，证件和车票准备好。
sentences.en: Okay, keep your ID and ticket ready.

sentences.zh: 我上车了，好久没坐过绿皮火车了，好激动。
sentences.en: Just got on the train! It's been forever since I took a green train—I'm so hyped!

sentences.zh: 终于开始这段旅程了。
sentences.en: The journey has finally begun.

sentences.zh: 我这次还买的硬座呢，因为我买票的时候硬卧和软卧都没有了。
sentences.en: I actually got a hard seat ticket this time because both hard and soft sleepers were completely sold out.

sentences.zh: 长时间坐硬座可能会有点累。
sentences.en: A long trip in a hard seat may be tiring.

sentences.zh: 硬座也没关系，硬座热闹，而且我的座位靠窗呢。
sentences.en: But hard seat is fine by me—it's way more lively, plus I lucked out with a window seat!

sentences.zh: 靠窗就能一路看风景了。
sentences.en: A window seat lets you enjoy the scenery.

sentences.zh: 哇路上的风景真是太美了。
sentences.en: Wow, the views along the way are absolutely breathtaking!

sentences.zh: 这就是坐火车旅行的魅力吧。
sentences.en: That's part of the magic of train travel.

sentences.zh: 有点饿了，我去餐车看看有没有好吃的。
sentences.en: I'm getting a little hungry—gonna hit up the dining car and see what's good!

sentences.zh: 看看有什么热乎的饭菜。
sentences.en: See what hot food they have.

sentences.zh: 气死我了，刚才跟我一个室友吵了一架。
sentences.en: I'm so pissed off—I just got into a huge fight with one of my roommates.

sentences.zh: 怎么了？
sentences.en: What happened?

sentences.zh: 她老是把垃圾放我桌子上，今天又把一张用过的纸放我桌子上。
sentences.en: She keeps leaving trash on my desk! Today, she put another used tissue right on my desk.

sentences.zh: 你的桌子应该被尊重。
sentences.en: Your desk deserves to be respected.

sentences.zh: 我跟她说你别把垃圾放我桌子上，她说我是不小心的。
sentences.en: I told her to stop leaving her trash on my desk, and she was like, "Oh, it was an accident."

sentences.zh: 你已经明确告诉她不要这样做了。
sentences.en: You've clearly asked her not to do it.

sentences.zh: 一次两次是不小心，这都至少八九次了还是不小心吗？
sentences.en: Once or twice is an accident, but this is at least the eighth or ninth time! How is that still an accident?

sentences.zh: 反复发生，难怪你不再相信这个解释。
sentences.en: No wonder that explanation feels unconvincing after so many times.

sentences.zh: 而且她有一次甚至把穿过的袜子放在我桌子上。
sentences.en: One time, she even put her dirty socks on my desk.

sentences.zh: 这会让人觉得很不被尊重。
sentences.en: That would feel disrespectful.

sentences.zh: 我都不知道这到底是不是在霸凌我，她对我一直都很不好。
sentences.en: I don't even know if she's bullying me at this point—she's always been so mean to me.

sentences.zh: 不管叫什么，这些行为都让你很难受。
sentences.en: Whatever the label, these actions are upsetting you.

sentences.zh: 我要告诉我爸妈和老师。
sentences.en: I'm gonna tell my parents and my advisor.

sentences.zh: 可以把发生的事情具体说清楚，寻求帮助。
sentences.en: Explain what happened clearly and ask for support.

sentences.zh: 真的受不了了，都不想住在这个宿舍了。
sentences.en: I seriously can't stand this anymore—I don't even wanna live in this dorm.

sentences.zh: 你可以和他们一起讨论更合适的住宿安排。
sentences.en: You can discuss a better living arrangement with them.

sentences.zh: 天呐给你讲一个超级大八卦！
sentences.en: Oh my god, I've got some big gossip!

sentences.zh: 什么事让你这么惊讶？
sentences.en: What surprised you so much?

sentences.zh: 我刚才在电影院看到我们公司的Amy和Tom了，你猜他俩在干嘛？
sentences.en: I just ran into Amy and Tom from work at the movies—guess what they were doing?

sentences.zh: 我猜不到，他们在做什么？
sentences.en: I can't guess. What were they doing?

sentences.zh: 他俩居然搂在一起，Tom还喂Amy吃爆米花！他们绝对是情侣！
sentences.en: They were literally cuddling, and Tom was feeding her popcorn! They're a hundred percent dating!

sentences.zh: 看起来很亲近，不过关系还是由他们自己说明。
sentences.en: They seem close, though their relationship is theirs to explain.

sentences.zh: 太不可思议了，他俩在公司几乎都不说话的。
sentences.en: That's so crazy—they barely even talk at the office.

sentences.zh: 工作时和私下的相处可能不同。
sentences.en: People may act differently at work and in private.

sentences.zh: 我从来没有想过他俩居然会在一起。
sentences.en: I would've never guessed they'd end up together.

sentences.zh: 这确实出乎你的意料。
sentences.en: It really caught you by surprise.

sentences.zh: 我们公司没有禁止办公室恋爱呀，他俩为什么不告诉大家呢?
sentences.en: Our company doesn't even have a rule against office romance—why are they keeping it a secret?

sentences.zh: 他们可能只是想保留私人空间。
sentences.en: They may simply prefer to keep their private life private.

sentences.zh: 反正我就跟你说说，我是不会告诉别的同事的，人家不想让大家知道肯定有人家的原因。
sentences.en: Anyway, I'm only telling you—I won't tell anyone else at work. They must have their reasons for keeping it low-key.

sentences.zh: 尊重他们的选择很好。
sentences.en: It's good to respect their choice.

sentences.zh: 我已经买好下周去济州岛的机票啦。
sentences.en: I already booked my flight to Jeju Island for next week!

sentences.zh: 行程越来越近了！
sentences.en: Your trip is getting closer!

sentences.zh: 我刚才在手机上定了一个民宿。
sentences.en: I actually just booked an Airbnb on my phone.

sentences.zh: 住处也订好了呀。
sentences.en: You've booked your accommodation, too.

sentences.zh: 这个民宿可棒了，还有一个大院子，是在一个村里。
sentences.en: This place looks amazing—it even has a big yard, and it's located in a little village.

sentences.zh: 带院子的民宿很有生活气息。
sentences.en: A guesthouse with a yard sounds homely.

sentences.zh: 这个村子也很方便，离市区挺近的，村子里也有公交车站。
sentences.en: The village is super convenient too—it's close to downtown and has a bus stop right there.

sentences.zh: 位置方便，出行也省心。
sentences.en: A convenient location makes getting around easier.

sentences.zh: 本来我是想定酒店的，但是我看好多攻略都说住民宿更好。
sentences.en: I was gonna book a hotel, but I read a bunch of travel blogs that recommended staying at an Airbnb.

sentences.zh: 选符合自己需要的就好。
sentences.en: Choose what suits your own needs.

sentences.zh: 我现在要开始准备收拾行李了。
sentences.en: Now I need to get cracking on packing my bags!

sentences.zh: 先列个清单，免得漏东西。
sentences.en: Make a list so you don't forget anything.

sentences.zh: 我去玩5天我要带5套衣服，每天都要出片。
sentences.en: I'm going for five days, so I'm bringing five outfits—I gotta look photo-ready every single day!

sentences.zh: 每天都准备了不同的搭配。
sentences.en: A different outfit for every day!

sentences.zh: 哎呀我要先买个行李箱，我这个行李箱太小了。
sentences.en: Oh shoot, I gotta buy a new suitcase first—mine is way too small.

sentences.zh: 先看看行李限额，再选箱子大小。
sentences.en: Check your baggage allowance before choosing a suitcase.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥今天终于找到工作了。
sentences.en: My brother finally landed a job today.

sentences.zh: 太好了，替他开心！
sentences.en: That's great. I'm happy for him!

sentences.zh: 他之前失业了半年，每天都在投简历。
sentences.en: He'd been unemployed for six months, just sending out resumes every single day.

sentences.zh: 这半年一定很不容易。
sentences.en: Those six months must have been tough.

sentences.zh: 今天终于收到一家公司的录用通知了。
sentences.en: And today he finally got a job offer.

sentences.zh: 终于等到好消息了。
sentences.en: The good news finally arrived.

sentences.zh: 他现在是个副经理，虽然工资没有以前高，但是他还是特别开心。
sentences.en: He's an assistant manager now. The pay's not as good as his old job, but he's still super happy.

sentences.zh: 重新开始带来的开心很重要。
sentences.en: The happiness of a fresh start matters.

sentences.zh: 我爸妈也终于放心了。
sentences.en: My parents are finally relieved too.

sentences.zh: 一家人都松了口气。
sentences.en: The whole family can breathe easier.

sentences.zh: 晚上我们准备出去吃饭庆祝一下。
sentences.en: We're gonna go out for dinner tonight to celebrate.

sentences.zh: 值得好好庆祝一下。
sentences.en: That's worth celebrating.

sentences.zh: 我哥哥还说发了第一个月的工资要给我买个新手机。
sentences.en: My brother even said he'll buy me a new phone with his first paycheck.

sentences.zh: 他还惦记着给你买礼物呢。
sentences.en: He's already thinking of a gift for you.

sentences.zh: 太开心了我要有新手机了！
sentences.en: I'm so stoked—I'm getting a new phone!

sentences.zh: 今天我小姨生孩子了，现在我们一大家子人都在医院。
sentences.en: My aunt had a baby today, and our whole family is at the hospital right now.

sentences.zh: 恭喜你们家添了新成员！
sentences.en: Congratulations on the new family member!

sentences.zh: 小宝宝是个小女孩，我终于有表妹了。
sentences.en: It's a little girl—I finally have a cousin sister!

sentences.zh: 你终于有小表妹了。
sentences.en: You finally have a little cousin!

sentences.zh: 小宝宝长得超级可爱，因为我小姨和姨夫也都长得很好看。
sentences.en: She's so cute. Her parents are both really good-looking, so it makes sense.

sentences.zh: 你一定忍不住一直看她。
sentences.en: You must want to keep looking at her.

sentences.zh: 她的名字是我起的呢，我之前就说如果是小女孩就叫Lily，如果是小男孩就叫Eric.
sentences.en: I actually came up with her name! I said earlier if it was a girl we'd go with Lily, and if it was a boy, Eric.

sentences.zh: 原来两个名字都提前准备好了。
sentences.en: You had a name ready either way.

sentences.zh: 现在大家都围着她叫她Lily.
sentences.en: Now everyone's gathered around her calling her Lily.

sentences.zh: Lily 是个很好听的名字。
sentences.en: Lily is a lovely name.

sentences.zh: 我还给她带了一个礼物呢，是一个毛绒玩具。
sentences.en: I brought her a present too—a stuffed animal.

sentences.zh: 你还专门给她准备了礼物。
sentences.en: You picked out a gift just for her.

sentences.zh: 这个毛绒玩具是一个小马，你猜我为什么送她小马。
sentences.en: It's a little pony. Wanna guess why I picked that?

sentences.zh: 是有什么特别的寓意吗？
sentences.en: Does the horse have a special meaning?

sentences.zh: 因为今年是马年，Lily属马。
sentences.en: 'Cause this year's the Year of the Horse, and Lily's a little horse baby!

sentences.zh: 我今天去姑姑家玩了，好开心。
sentences.en: I went to my aunt's place today and had so much fun.

sentences.zh: 和家人见面很开心吧。
sentences.en: It must be nice to see family.

sentences.zh: 终于见到姑姑了，我好几个月都没见过她了，她是个警察，平常特别忙。
sentences.en: I finally got to see her—I hadn't seen her in months. She's a cop and she's always crazy busy.

sentences.zh: 忙碌之余能聚一下，很难得。
sentences.en: It's special to meet when she's so busy.

sentences.zh: 晚饭是我姑父做的，他做饭特别好吃。
sentences.en: My uncle made dinner, and he's an amazing cook.

sentences.zh: 姑父做了什么好菜？
sentences.en: What did your uncle cook?

sentences.zh: 你猜他是做什么工作的？
sentences.en: Wanna guess what he does for a living?

sentences.zh: 难道是和做饭有关的？
sentences.en: Is his job connected with cooking?

sentences.zh: 他是个记者，但是他说他其实更想做厨师。
sentences.en: He's a journalist, but he says he actually wanted to be a chef.

sentences.zh: 原来厨师才是他心里的愿望。
sentences.en: So being a chef is what he'd really like.

sentences.zh: 他从小就超喜欢做饭，但是我爷爷奶奶不同意他做厨师。
sentences.en: He's loved cooking since he was a kid, but my grandparents wouldn't let him be a chef.

sentences.zh: 他的职业选择也受到家人影响。
sentences.en: His family influenced his career choice, too.

sentences.zh: 他今晚做了个红烧肉，天呐，是我这辈子吃过最好吃的。
sentences.en: Tonight he made braised pork belly, and oh my god—it was the best thing I've ever eaten in my life.

sentences.zh: 这道红烧肉让你彻底喜欢上了。
sentences.en: That braised pork really won you over.

sentences.zh: 我一口气吃了两碗大米饭，妈呀，要是每天都在他们家吃饭我得胖死。
sentences.en: I wolfed down two big bowls of rice. God, if I ate at their place every day, I'd get so fat.

sentences.zh: 最近我掉头发有点严重。
sentences.en: I've been losing a lot of hair lately.

sentences.zh: 最近比平时明显多了吗？
sentences.en: Has it increased noticeably lately?

sentences.zh: 我每天洗头和梳头的时候，都会掉很多头发。
sentences.en: Every time I wash or brush my hair, clumps of it come out.

sentences.zh: 如果持续这样，可以找医生检查原因。
sentences.en: If it continues, a doctor can help check the cause.

sentences.zh: 最近也老是头疼，可能是睡眠不足。
sentences.en: I've also been getting headaches a lot—probably from not getting enough sleep.

sentences.zh: 头疼和睡不好都值得关注。
sentences.en: Headaches and poor sleep deserve attention.

sentences.zh: 我这一个月都是10点以后才下班的。
sentences.en: I've been getting off work after ten PM every single night for the past month.

sentences.zh: 连续加班一个月，确实辛苦。
sentences.en: A month of late work sounds exhausting.

sentences.zh: 我真的想离职了，现在不止是掉头发和头疼，我腰也疼，手腕也疼。
sentences.en: I seriously wanna quit. It's not just the hair loss and headaches anymore—my lower back hurts, my wrists hurt too.

sentences.zh: 这些不适别一直拖着，先照顾身体。
sentences.en: Don't keep putting off those symptoms. Take care of yourself.

sentences.zh: 但是我这个工作月薪2万块呢，我又舍不得离职。
sentences.en: But I'm making twenty K a month at this job, so I can't bring myself to leave.

sentences.zh: 收入和健康之间的取舍让你很纠结。
sentences.en: You're torn between the income and your health.

sentences.zh: 今天我先早点睡觉，明天醒来再考虑到底要不要离职吧。
sentences.en: I'm gonna crash early tonight and figure out whether to quit or not when I wake up tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 好，休息后再慢慢考虑。
sentences.en: Okay. Think it through after some rest.

sentences.zh: 我好喜欢喝酒
sentences.en: I love drinking so much.

sentences.zh: 你喜欢哪一种？
sentences.en: What kinds do you enjoy?

sentences.zh: 啤酒白酒红酒鸡尾酒我都很喜欢。
sentences.en: Beer, baijiu, wine, cocktails—I like all of 'em.

sentences.zh: 种类还真不少。
sentences.en: That's quite a variety.

sentences.zh: 不过喝酒好像很伤肝脏，对肾脏也不太好
sentences.en: But I heard it's really hard on your liver, and not great for your kidneys either.

sentences.zh: 酒精确实有健康风险，喝得少也不是完全没风险。
sentences.en: Alcohol carries health risks, even at lower amounts.

sentences.zh: 我一次可以喝10瓶啤酒。
sentences.en: I can down ten bottles of beer in one go.

sentences.zh: 十瓶很多了，不要把酒量当作安全标准。
sentences.en: Ten bottles is a lot. Tolerance isn't a measure of safety.

sentences.zh: 他们说喝酒脸红的人不能喝酒，我不脸红。
sentences.en: They say people who get flush when they drink shouldn't drink—but I don't turn red.

sentences.zh: 不脸红也不代表酒精没有伤害。
sentences.en: Not turning red doesn't mean alcohol is harmless.

sentences.zh: 不过我每次喝完酒第二天胃都不舒服。
sentences.en: But my stomach always feels awful the morning after.

sentences.zh: 反复胃不舒服，值得和医生谈谈。
sentences.en: Repeated stomach discomfort is worth discussing with a doctor.

sentences.zh: 以后我还是要少喝点，不能一次喝太多。
sentences.en: I should probably cut back and not drink so much in one sitting.

sentences.zh: 减少饮酒是你可以认真考虑的一步。
sentences.en: Reducing your drinking is a step worth considering.

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友每次喝完酒心跳都特别快，他去年就戒酒了。
sentences.en: A friend of mine, his heart goes crazy every time he drinks—he quit last year.

sentences.zh: 身体不舒服时停下来并寻求帮助很重要。
sentences.en: It's important to stop and seek help when symptoms occur.

sentences.zh: 我打算以后每周一三五都去健身。
sentences.en: I'm planning to hit the gym every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

sentences.zh: 你已经排好固定的训练日了。
sentences.en: You've picked regular training days.

sentences.zh: 周一练背和胸，周三练肩和手臂，周五练臀腿，你觉得怎么样？
sentences.en: Mondays for back and chest, Wednesdays for shoulders and arms, Fridays for glutes and legs—what do you think?

sentences.zh: 可以让教练结合你的情况调整强度。
sentences.en: A trainer can adjust the intensity to suit you.

sentences.zh: 你觉得我需要单独练一下核心吗？
sentences.en: Do you think I need to work on my core separately?

sentences.zh: 核心训练是否增加，可以和教练一起安排。
sentences.en: You can plan core training with your trainer.

sentences.zh: 我还想每天跑半个小时步，但是又有点怕伤膝盖。
sentences.en: I also wanna run for half an hour every day, but I'm kinda scared of messing up my knees.

sentences.zh: 先根据自己的情况逐步开始。
sentences.en: Start gradually based on your own condition.

sentences.zh: 我听别人说跑步会让小腿变的很粗，真的吗？
sentences.en: I heard running makes your calves super bulky—is that true?

sentences.zh: 不一定，腿型变化不能只归因于跑步。
sentences.en: Not necessarily. Leg shape changes can't be blamed on running alone.

sentences.zh: 我去年跑步把脚扭了，到现在快一年都没跑步了。
sentences.en: I sprained my ankle running last year and haven't gone running in almost a year.

sentences.zh: 有过旧伤，重新开始前可以先评估恢复情况。
sentences.en: With a previous injury, check your recovery before restarting.

sentences.zh: 我得先买双跑鞋，现在脚上这双一跑步就脚趾头疼。
sentences.en: I need to get a new pair of running shoes first—the ones I have now make my toes hurt every time I run.

sentences.zh: 会让脚趾疼的鞋不适合继续穿着跑。
sentences.en: Shoes that hurt your toes aren't suitable for running.

sentences.zh: 等我的鞋到了我再开始健身。
sentences.en: I'll start working out once my shoes arrive.

sentences.zh: 鞋子合适后，也要循序渐进。
sentences.en: Even with suitable shoes, build up gradually.

sentences.zh: 我刚照镜子突然发现我的头发长长了好多啊。
sentences.en: I just looked in the mirror and realized my hair's gotten so long.

sentences.zh: 不知不觉就长了不少。
sentences.en: It grew quite a bit without you noticing.

sentences.zh: 我感觉我应该去剪头发了。
sentences.en: I feel like I should go get a haircut.

sentences.zh: 想剪掉多少？
sentences.en: How much would you like to cut?

sentences.zh: 但是我特别怕理发师给我剪的太短了
sentences.en: But I'm so scared the hairdresser will chop off way too much.

sentences.zh: 可以把想保留的长度说得具体些。
sentences.en: Be specific about the length you want to keep.

sentences.zh: 好多理发师都跟听不懂人话一样，你说剪一点点，他能给你剪15cm.
sentences.en: So many hairdressers just don't get it—you ask for a tiny trim, and they cut off five inches!

sentences.zh: 剪短太多确实很难马上补救。
sentences.en: It's hard to undo a cut that's too short.

sentences.zh: 要不我自己剪算了，还省钱呢
sentences.en: Maybe I should just do it myself—save some money too.

sentences.zh: 自己剪也可能不容易剪齐。
