sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，我看一下，您的手机尾号是1234，是订的一个标准间，入住三天对吗？
sentences.en: Let me take a look—I see a reservation under the phone number ending in one-two-three-four. A standard room for three nights, is that right?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 对的，这些信息都没错。
sentences.en: Yes, that's all correct.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 我们现在可以免费给您升级成视野更好的大床房，或者加100块钱可以升级成套房，您看您需要吗？
sentences.en: We can upgrade you for free to a king room with a better view, or for an extra one hundred dollars, you can upgrade to a suite. Would you like to do that?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 谢谢，给我免费升级的大床房就好。
sentences.en: Thank you. I'd like the complimentary upgrade to the king room.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，可以给我一下您的证件吗？
sentences.en: Great, may I have your ID, please?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 当然，这是我的护照。
sentences.en: Of course. Here's my passport.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 我们需要提前收取100块的押金哦。
sentences.en: We'll just need a one-hundred-dollar deposit for the stay.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 没问题，可以用信用卡支付吗？
sentences.en: No problem. Can I pay by credit card?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，您这个房间是包含早餐的，早餐是7点到10点，餐厅在3楼。
sentences.en: Your room includes breakfast—it's served from seven to ten AM, and the restaurant is on the third floor.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，早餐在三楼，七点到十点，我记住了。
sentences.en: Okay, breakfast is on the third floor from seven to ten. Got it.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 这是您的房卡，房间在8楼，电梯在拐角处。wifi和密码在房卡套上。

sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 谢谢，我先上去了。
sentences.en: Thank you. I'll head up now.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 您好，是要退房吗？

sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.en: Yes, I'd like to check out. Here's the key card.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，押金已经退给您了。
sentences.en: All set, your deposit has been refunded.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢你帮忙。
sentences.en: Great, thank you for your help.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 欢迎下次光临。
sentences.en: Thank you for staying with us! Have a safe trip!
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 谢谢，再见！
sentences.en: Thank you. Goodbye!
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演顾客，你扮演店员

sentences.zh: 您好，欢迎光临。请问有什么可以帮您？
sentences.en: Hello, welcome. How may I help you?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 你好，我办入住，我在网上预订的，名字是Shandy。
sentences.en: Hi, I'm checking in—I have a reservation under Shandy.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的，Shandy。请出示您的护照和用于办理入住的信用卡。
sentences.en: Certainly, Shandy. May I see your passport and a credit card for check-in?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 这是我的护照和信用卡。
sentences.en: Here's my passport and credit card.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 谢谢，预订已经找到了。您对房间有什么偏好吗？
sentences.en: Thank you. I've found your reservation. Do you have any room preferences?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 有没有高一点楼层的房间，我们喜欢高一点的。
sentences.en: Do you have any available rooms on a higher floor? We prefer a higher floor.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 有的，可以为您安排十楼的房间。
sentences.en: Yes, we can give you a room on the tenth floor.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的，谢谢
sentences.en: Perfect, thank you.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 不客气。这是您的房卡，还有什么可以帮您的吗？
sentences.en: You're welcome. Here's your key card. Is there anything else I can help with?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 我们这个房间是包含早餐的对吧，几点呢？
sentences.en: Does our room come with breakfast? What time is it served?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 是的，包含早餐，供应时间是早上七点到十点，餐厅在三楼。
sentences.en: Yes, breakfast is included. It's served from seven to ten in the morning in the restaurant on the third floor.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的，有没有公用的洗衣房呢？
sentences.en: Got it. Is there a guest laundry room here?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 有的，洗衣房在二楼，具体使用说明贴在房间内。
sentences.en: Yes, the laundry room is on the second floor. The instructions are posted inside.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的，请问一下WIFI是哪个？
sentences.en: Got it. What's the Wi-Fi name?
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 网络名称和密码都写在房卡套上。
sentences.en: The network name and password are both on your key-card holder.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 谢谢。
sentences.en: Thanks.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 不客气，祝您入住愉快。
sentences.en: You're welcome. Enjoy your stay.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 你好，退房。
sentences.en: Hi, I'd like to check out, please.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的，请把房卡给我。我确认一下是否还有未结费用。
sentences.en: Certainly. May I have your key card? I'll check whether there are any outstanding charges.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 好的谢谢。
sentences.en: Perfect, thank you!
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 已经办好了，没有其他费用。祝您旅途愉快，再见。
sentences.en: You're all checked out, with no additional charges. Have a good trip. Goodbye.
sentences.context: 场景：在酒店办理入住，对方扮演店员，你扮演顾客

sentences.zh: 我最好的朋友Linda下个月要结婚了！我要去给她当伴娘。
sentences.en: My best friend Linda is getting married next month! I'm gonna be her bridesmaid.

sentences.zh: 太好了！能给最好的朋友当伴娘，一定很期待吧。
sentences.en: That's wonderful! You must be excited to be your best friend's bridesmaid.

sentences.zh: 我们伴娘伴郎一共八个人，今天我要和linda一起去选衣服。
sentences.en: There are eight of us in the wedding party—bridesmaids and groomsmen. Today I'm going with Linda to pick out everyone's outfits.

sentences.zh: 八个人一起搭配服装，今天有得忙了。
sentences.en: Coordinating outfits for eight people will keep you busy today.

sentences.zh: 我们今天就要把新郎新娘还有伴娘伴郎的衣服都定了。
sentences.en: We're finalizing the outfits for the bride, groom, and everyone in the wedding party today.

sentences.zh: 希望大家都能选到合适的，也记得留出修改尺寸的时间。
sentences.en: I hope everyone finds a good fit. Leave time for alterations, too.

sentences.zh: 天呐，linda刚才跟我说她打算明年就要孩子。
sentences.en: Oh my god, Linda just told me she's planning to have a baby next year!

sentences.zh: 她已经在考虑下一阶段的生活了，你听到时什么感觉？
sentences.en: She's already thinking about the next stage of life. How did you feel hearing that?

sentences.zh: 好震惊啊，我觉得我们都还是小朋友呢，没想到Linda要做妈妈了。
sentences.en: I'm in shock—I still feel like we're just kids. I can't believe Linda's gonna be a mom.

sentences.zh: 看着朋友进入新阶段，有时真的会突然觉得时间过得很快。
sentences.en: Seeing a friend enter a new stage can suddenly make time feel like it's flown by.

sentences.zh: 不过她俩感情很稳定，都一起五六年了。
sentences.en: But they're so solid together—they've been together for like five or six years.

sentences.zh: 相处这么久，他们应该也聊过不少对未来的期待。
sentences.en: After that long together, they've probably discussed many of their hopes for the future.

sentences.zh: 反正只要是她幸福就好了。
sentences.en: Anyway, as long as she's happy, that's all that really matters.

episodes.title: 喜欢的人正好也喜欢我

sentences.zh: 我喜欢上了一个男生。
sentences.en: I have a crush on a guy.

sentences.zh: 听起来有故事！你们是怎么认识的？
sentences.en: That sounds like a story! How did you meet?

sentences.zh: 他是物理学院的，我们在话剧社认识的。
sentences.en: He's a physics major—we met in the drama club.

sentences.zh: 在话剧社认识，应该有不少共同话题吧。
sentences.en: Meeting in the drama club must give you plenty to talk about.

sentences.zh: 我俩一样大，都是大二的，最近我们在排练一个话剧嘛，我是女主，他是男主。
sentences.en: We're both sophomores, same age. We've been rehearsing a play together lately—I'm the female lead and he's the male lead.

sentences.zh: 一起演男女主，排练时相处的机会也很多。
sentences.en: Playing the leads gives you lots of chances to spend time together during rehearsals.

sentences.zh: 我每次见到他都特别开心，心跳都好快。
sentences.en: Every time I see him, I just get so happy, and my heart starts racing.

sentences.zh: 喜欢一个人的时候，那种期待和紧张很明显。
sentences.en: When you like someone, that excitement and nervousness can really show.

sentences.zh: 我想跟他表白，但是不知道怎么说。
sentences.en: I wanna tell him how I feel, but I don't know how.

sentences.zh: 可以简单真诚一点，比如说你很喜欢和他相处，想单独约他出去。
sentences.en: Keep it simple and sincere. You could say you enjoy spending time with him and would like to go out together.

sentences.zh: 啊啊啊啊他刚才给我发微信了，他说：其实我很喜欢你！
sentences.en: Ahhh, he just texted me on WeChat! He said, "I actually really like you!"

sentences.zh: 哇，他先开口了！你准备怎么回复？
sentences.en: Wow, he said it first! How are you going to reply?

sentences.zh: 我说其实我也是。
sentences.en: I told him I feel the same way.

sentences.zh: 原来你们是互相喜欢，真让人开心。
sentences.en: So the feeling is mutual. That's lovely.

sentences.zh: 他来我们宿舍楼下了，不跟你说了，我要下去找他了。
sentences.en: He's downstairs at my dorm right now! Gotta go, I'm gonna go meet him!

sentences.zh: 去吧，祝你们今晚聊得开心！
sentences.en: Go on, then. I hope you have a lovely time together!

sentences.zh: 我给你说个大八卦！
sentences.en: I've got some major tea to spill!

sentences.zh: 发生什么事了？
sentences.en: What happened?

sentences.zh: 我一个朋友叫琳达，他老公出轨了。
sentences.en: So a friend of mine, Linda—her husband cheated on her.

sentences.zh: 如果属实，这对琳达一定是很大的打击。
sentences.en: If that's true, it must be a huge blow to Linda.

sentences.zh: 而且他好像还吸毒，警察已经把他带走了，要给他做检测呢。
sentences.en: And apparently he's doing drugs, too. The cops already took him in, and they're testing him.

sentences.zh: 这件事更严重了，不过检测结果出来前先别当成定论。
sentences.en: That's even more serious, but let's not treat it as confirmed before the test results are available.

sentences.zh: 他说他已经戒了，说之前是酒吧里的一个酒保骗他吸的。
sentences.en: He claims he quit and that some bartender tricked him into trying drugs.

sentences.zh: 那是他的说法，具体情况还需要核实。
sentences.en: That's his account. What happened still needs to be verified.

sentences.zh: 但是我们都不相信他，因为这个男的特别喜欢撒谎。
sentences.en: But none of us believe a word he says—the guy is a total liar.

sentences.zh: 信任已经受损，确实很难只凭解释就恢复。
sentences.en: Once trust is damaged, an explanation alone may not restore it.

sentences.zh: 他还特别抠，上次情人节琳达送了他一块5万块的表，你猜他送了Linda什么？
sentences.en: He's super cheap, too! Last Valentine's Day, Linda bought him a fifty-thousand-yuan watch. Guess what he gave her?

sentences.zh: 她送了这么贵重的礼物，他回赠了什么？
sentences.en: She gave him such an expensive gift. What did he give her?

sentences.zh: 一个电动牙刷，大概100块吧。
sentences.en: An electric toothbrush—probably worth like one hundred bucks.

sentences.zh: 价格差距很大，不过更关键的可能是她有没有被重视的感觉。
sentences.en: That's a big price difference, though what may matter more is whether she feels valued.

sentences.zh: 现在琳达在法国度假，打算回来就和他离婚。
sentences.en: Linda's vacationing in France right now, and she's planning to file for divorce as soon as she gets back.

sentences.zh: 希望她先照顾好自己，做重要决定时也能得到可靠的支持。
sentences.en: I hope she takes care of herself and gets reliable support when making important decisions.

sentences.zh: 刚和一个朋友吵架了。
sentences.en: I just got into an argument with a friend.

sentences.zh: 怎么吵起来的？你现在已经安全停车了吗？
sentences.en: What started the argument? Are you safely parked now?

sentences.zh: 我们本来在车上嘛，我在开车，他在副驾。
sentences.en: We were in the car—I was driving and he was riding shotgun.

sentences.zh: 在车上有矛盾很影响情绪，发生什么了？
sentences.en: An argument in the car can be upsetting. What happened?

sentences.zh: 我开的比较慢，因为那条路上写的限速30，但是别的车都挺快的，他就非要让我加速。
sentences.en: I was driving kind of slow because the speed limit was thirty, but other cars were speeding past, so he kept pushing me to speed up.

sentences.zh: 别人开得快不代表你也要超速，按限速开是合理的。
sentences.en: Other drivers going faster doesn't mean you should speed. Following the limit is reasonable.

sentences.zh: 我说这限速30啊，他说：但是别人都在超你的车，所有人都在超你的车。
sentences.en: I told him the limit was thirty, and he was like, "But everyone's passing you—literally everyone!"

sentences.zh: 一直被催确实会烦，但被超车本身不是加速的理由。
sentences.en: Being pushed like that is frustrating, but being overtaken isn't a reason to speed.

sentences.zh: 超我车怎么了？我遵守交通规则有什么错？
sentences.en: So what if they are? What's wrong with following the rules?

sentences.zh: 遵守限速没有错，也可以明确告诉他不要干扰你驾驶。
sentences.en: There's nothing wrong with obeying the limit. You can tell him clearly not to distract you while driving.

sentences.zh: 然后我们就开始冷战，谁也不说话。
sentences.en: After that, we didn't say another word to each other.

sentences.zh: 先把车安全开好，情绪平静一点再聊也可以。
sentences.en: Focus on driving safely. You can talk once you've both calmed down.

sentences.zh: 后来又开了几个红绿灯吧，路过一个广场的时候，他说你把我放这吧。
sentences.en: A few traffic lights later, as we passed a plaza, he was like, "Just drop me off here."

sentences.zh: 如果他要下车，就找个允许停车、也安全的位置。
sentences.en: If he wants to get out, find a safe place where stopping is allowed.

sentences.zh: 然后我就把他放那了。本来我们是要一起去商场吃饭的。
sentences.en: So I just dropped him off right there. We were actually supposed to go to the mall for dinner together.

sentences.zh: 原本的晚饭计划也泡汤了，难怪你不开心。
sentences.en: That spoiled your dinner plans, too. No wonder you're upset.

sentences.zh: 反正我是不会跟他道歉的，我没有任何错。
sentences.en: Anyway, I'm definitely not apologizing to him—I did nothing wrong.

sentences.zh: 你不需要为守限速道歉。等冷静后，可以再谈谈彼此说话的方式。
sentences.en: You don't need to apologize for obeying the limit. Once you're calm, you can talk about how you spoke to each other.

sentences.zh: 我到机场啦，现在要去值机托运行李。
sentences.en: I made it to the airport—gonna check in and drop off my bags now.

sentences.zh: 先看看值机柜台在哪，证件也准备好。
sentences.en: Check where the check-in counter is and have your documents ready.

sentences.zh: 妈呀我的行李居然超重了，我刚才把里面的一件厚皮衣拿出来穿上了，这件衣服可重了。
sentences.en: Oh no, my bag is actually overweight! I just pulled out a heavy leather jacket and put it on—this thing weighs a ton!

sentences.zh: 厚皮衣确实占重量，重新称过了吗？
sentences.en: A thick leather jacket can weigh a lot. Have they weighed the bag again?

sentences.zh: 这件衣服拿出来行李就不超重了。
sentences.en: Now that I took it out, my bag is under the limit!

sentences.zh: 问题解决了就好，接下来可以安心过安检了。
sentences.en: Glad that's sorted. Now you can head to security.

sentences.zh: 我要去安检啦。
sentences.en: Heading through security now!

sentences.zh: 好，留意现场要求，随身物品别落下。
sentences.en: Okay, follow the instructions there and don't leave anything behind.

sentences.zh: 我的充电宝不能带上飞机，因为没有3C标志，只能把充电宝扔掉了。
sentences.en: My power bank isn't allowed on the plane because it doesn't have the 3C label—I had to throw it away.

sentences.zh: 遇到不能携带的物品，按现场安检人员的指引处理就好。
sentences.en: If an item isn't allowed, follow the security staff's instructions on what to do with it.

sentences.zh: 我现在在登机口等飞机啦。
sentences.en: I'm at the gate waiting for my flight now.

sentences.zh: 终于可以坐下歇一会儿了，记得留意登机通知。
sentences.en: You can finally sit down for a rest. Keep an eye on the boarding announcements.

sentences.zh: 我们终于要登机了，我今天来的太早了。
sentences.en: We're finally boarding—I showed up way too early today!

sentences.zh: 早点来虽然等得久，但至少不用一路赶。
sentences.en: Arriving early means more waiting, but at least you didn't have to rush.

sentences.zh: 不跟你说了，我们要起飞了。
sentences.en: Gotta run—we're taking off!

sentences.zh: 好，按机组要求设置手机，祝你飞行顺利！
sentences.en: Okay, set your phone as the crew instructs. Have a good flight!

sentences.zh: 我落地啦，终于到泰国了。
sentences.en: I've landed—finally made it to Thailand!

sentences.zh: 终于到了！这一路飞得顺利吗？
sentences.en: You're finally there! Did the flight go smoothly?

sentences.zh: 刚才有个人帮我把包从行李架上拿下来了，好善良呀。
sentences.en: Someone just helped me grab my bag from the overhead bin—that was so nice of them!

sentences.zh: 旅途中遇到愿意帮忙的人，感觉很温暖。
sentences.en: Meeting someone helpful while traveling feels lovely.

sentences.zh: 哎呀居然还要坐摆渡车，不喜欢坐摆渡车。
sentences.en: Ugh, we have to take a shuttle bus... I seriously hate shuttle buses.

sentences.zh: 还得再等一程，先跟着指示走吧。
sentences.en: One more ride to go. Follow the signs for now.

sentences.zh: 我现在要去取行李了。
sentences.en: Heading to baggage claim now.

sentences.zh: 看看行李转盘号码，希望不用等太久。
sentences.en: Check your baggage carousel number. I hope you don't have to wait long.

sentences.zh: 我等的花都快谢了，我的行李怎么还不来。
sentences.en: I've been waiting here forever—where on earth is my bag?

sentences.zh: 等行李最考验耐心了，也确认一下是不是这个转盘。
sentences.en: Waiting for bags really tests your patience. Double-check that you're at the right carousel.

sentences.zh: 拿到行李了，我现在在过海关了。
sentences.en: Got my bag! Now I'm heading through customs.

sentences.zh: 拿到就安心了，接下来按机场标识和工作人员指引走。
sentences.en: Glad you have it. Follow the airport signs and staff instructions from here.

sentences.zh: 我现在要去订的酒店了，酒店有专车来机场接我们呢。
sentences.en: Now I'm heading to my hotel—they actually sent a car to pick us up!

sentences.zh: 有接送就省事了，先核对好酒店发来的接车信息。
sentences.en: A pickup makes things easier. Confirm the details the hotel sent you.

sentences.zh: 我坐上车啦，一会儿到酒店再跟你说。
sentences.en: I'm in the car—I'll talk to you when I get to the hotel!

sentences.zh: 好，路上休息一下，到了再聊。
sentences.en: Okay, rest on the way. We'll talk when you arrive.

sentences.zh: 最近我朋友圈好多人都去俄罗斯玩了，我也想去。
sentences.en: So many people on my WeChat feed have been visiting Russia lately—I wanna go too!

sentences.zh: 看到朋友们的照片，很容易心动吧。
sentences.en: Seeing your friends' photos can make a trip very tempting.

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯现在是免签的，拿着护照就能去。
sentences.en: Russia is visa-free for us right now—you can just head over with your passport.

sentences.zh: 免签条件可能随时间、护照和旅行方式变化，订行程前要查官方要求，不能只凭这句话判断。
sentences.en: Visa-free conditions can vary with the date, passport, and type of trip. Check official requirements before booking rather than relying on that claim alone.

sentences.zh: 我看网上的攻略说可以先坐高铁去珲春，然后直接在珲春坐大巴就可以去俄罗斯。
sentences.en: I saw a travel guide online saying you can take the high-speed train to Hunchun, and then take a bus straight into Russia.

sentences.zh: 这条路线可以再核实班次、口岸开放情况和入境条件。
sentences.en: Check the transport schedule, border-crossing arrangements, and entry requirements for that route.

sentences.zh: 不过我想先在珲春玩一天，他们说珲春的海鲜特别好吃。
sentences.en: But I wanna spend a day in Hunchun first—people say the seafood there is to die for!

sentences.zh: 先停一天尝尝当地美食，也能让行程不那么赶。
sentences.en: Stopping for a day to try the local food could make the trip less rushed.

sentences.zh: 在珲春就可以看到俄罗斯和朝鲜呢。
sentences.en: From Hunchun, you can actually catch a glimpse of both Russia and North Korea.

sentences.zh: 边境景观听起来很特别，具体能看到什么还要看观景位置和天气。
sentences.en: The border scenery sounds interesting. What you can see will depend on the viewpoint and weather.

sentences.zh: 我其实也挺想去朝鲜玩一下的。
sentences.en: Honestly, I'd low-key love to visit North Korea too.

sentences.zh: 那里的旅游安排也需要另查官方要求，先把这次行程定清楚吧。
sentences.en: Travel arrangements there would need a separate check of official requirements. Focus on this trip first.

sentences.zh: 还是先去俄罗斯吧，我要报团去，自由行的话怕语言不通。
sentences.en: I'll stick with Russia first though. I'm gonna join a tour group because I'm worried about the language barrier if I travel solo.

sentences.zh: 跟团能减少一些沟通压力，不过还是要看清行程和服务内容。
sentences.en: A group tour can reduce some communication stress, but check the itinerary and included services carefully.

sentences.zh: 俄罗斯报团还挺便宜的耶。
sentences.en: The tour packages to Russia are surprisingly affordable!

sentences.zh: 别只看起价，也核对签证安排、额外费用和退改条件。
sentences.en: Look beyond the starting price. Check visa arrangements, extra costs, and cancellation terms, too.

sentences.zh: 刚才有个外国人来跟我问路了。
sentences.en: A foreigner just came up and asked me for directions!

sentences.zh: 你们聊得顺利吗？他要去哪里？
sentences.en: Did the conversation go smoothly? Where did he want to go?

sentences.zh: 他问我地铁站怎么走，我跟他说你就直直地往下走，在前面第二个十字路口右转就能看到。
sentences.en: He asked how to get to the subway station, so I told him to just keep walking straight, take a right at the second intersection, you'll see it on your right.

sentences.zh: 这个路线说明很清楚，他听懂了吗？
sentences.en: Those directions sound clear. Did he understand?

sentences.zh: 但是他没有听懂，所以我帮他下了一个高德，教他怎么用高德了。
sentences.en: But he didn't quite get it, so I helped him download Amap and walked him through how to use it.

sentences.zh: 你真耐心，用地图展示路线也更直观。
sentences.en: That was patient of you. Showing the route on a map makes it easier to follow.

sentences.zh: 他是个瑞士人，第一次来中国玩。
sentences.en: Turns out he's Swiss—it's his first time visiting China.

sentences.zh: 第一次来可能还有很多不熟悉的地方，遇到你帮忙真好。
sentences.en: There may be a lot he isn't familiar with on his first visit. It's nice that you could help.

sentences.zh: 他说特别喜欢中国，还送给我了一盒瑞士的巧克力。
sentences.en: He said he's loving China so far, and he even gave me a box of Swiss chocolates!

sentences.zh: 这是个很暖心的回礼，你的帮助让他留下了好印象。
sentences.en: That's a thoughtful thank-you gift. Your help left a good impression.

sentences.zh: 我还给他推荐了一些景点呢。
sentences.en: I even recommended a few local spots for him to check out.

sentences.zh: 这下他不但知道怎么坐地铁，还有了游玩的方向。
sentences.en: Now he knows how to get to the metro and has some ideas for sightseeing.

sentences.zh: 哇我刚尝了一下这个巧克力，也太好吃了！怪不得都说瑞士巧克力世界第一呢。
sentences.en: Wow, I just tried one—it was so good! No wonder Swiss chocolate is known as the best in the world.

sentences.zh: 看来很合你的口味！是不是第一各有看法，但这份小礼物确实让你很开心。
sentences.en: It really suits your taste! Whether it's the best is a matter of opinion, but this little gift has clearly made you happy.

sentences.zh: 我这次出来旅游真是倒霉透顶。
sentences.en: This trip has been a total nightmare!

sentences.zh: 怎么了？旅途中发生什么事了？
sentences.en: What happened? What went wrong on the trip?

sentences.zh: 我一出机场就被人偷了一个包，那个包里有我的电脑，梳子香水手链吹风机。
sentences.en: Right as I stepped out of the airport, my bag got stolen—it had my laptop, comb, perfume, bracelet, and hair dryer in it!

sentences.zh: 那太糟了。先确保自己安全，联系当地警方，并保护电脑上可能登录的账号。
sentences.en: That's awful. Make sure you're safe, contact the local police, and secure any accounts that may be signed in on the laptop.

sentences.zh: 而且我到酒店之后发现我景点的门票买错了。
sentences.en: On top of that, after I checked into the hotel, I realized I bought tickets for the wrong date.

sentences.zh: 又遇到一个问题，门票是哪儿买错了？
sentences.en: Another problem? What was wrong with the tickets?

sentences.zh: 我以为我买的是9月20号的，结果我买成了21号。
sentences.en: I thought I booked them for September twentieth, but I accidentally got them for the twenty-first!

sentences.zh: 日期差了一天，可以先看看能不能更改。
sentences.en: The date is one day off. Check whether it can be changed.

sentences.zh: 我想重新买20号的，但是已经没票了，可是21号我就要回去了。
sentences.en: I tried to rebook for the twentieth, but it's completely sold out—and I'm heading back on the twenty-first!

sentences.zh: 那确实遗憾，可以问客服能否退款或有没有其他处理办法。
sentences.en: That's disappointing. Ask customer service whether a refund or another solution is possible.

sentences.zh: 而且我订的这个酒店隔音特别差，我现在都能听到隔壁在说什么。
sentences.en: To make matters worse, the soundproofing in this hotel is awful—I can literally hear every word the neighbors are saying right now.

sentences.zh: 本来想休息一下，结果连房间也不安静。可以问前台能否换房。
sentences.en: You wanted to rest, but even the room isn't quiet. Ask the front desk whether you can change rooms.

sentences.zh: 这个酒店还很贵呢，在市中心。
sentences.en: And this place isn't even cheap—it's right downtown.

sentences.zh: 位置方便却没住舒服，会觉得这笔钱花得不值。
sentences.en: A convenient location doesn't make up for an uncomfortable stay. It can feel like poor value.

sentences.zh: 我还是先去吃点好吃的吧。
sentences.en: Whatever, I'm just gonna go eat my feelings and grab something good.

sentences.zh: 先吃点东西、缓缓情绪吧，剩下的问题再一件一件处理。
sentences.en: Get something to eat and take a breather. Then deal with the remaining problems one at a time.
